item.title: Sinner withdraws from US open due to knee injury
item.description: World number one Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the U.S. Open due to a persistent right knee injury, the Italian said on Friday, depriving the season's final Grand Slam of one of its biggest contenders.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World number one Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the U.S. Open due to a persistent right knee injury, the Italian said on Friday, depriving the season's final Grand Slam of one of its biggest contenders. The 24-year-old, who captured his [USN:L8N43E08F TEXT:"fifth major title at Wimbledon"] last month, has not played since sustaining the injury earlier this month. He pulled out of the [USN:L4N44602M TEXT:"Cincinnati Open"] and also skipped the Canadian Open, two key hard-court tune-up events ahead of the Grand Slam tournament in New York. "Even though I have been working hard with my team and my medical staff, we have now had to make the difficult decision that I will not be able to compete at the U.S. Open this year," Sinner said in a statement posted on X. "We have been back on court in Monte Carlo over the last couple of days and have realised that I still need more time to recover from my right knee issue." The announcement comes a day after world number two [USN:L1N44H0TG TEXT:"Carlos Alcaraz"] confirmed he would compete at Flushing Meadows following a four-month absence from competitive tennis. Alcaraz, who beat Sinner in last year's U.S. Open final, now heads to New York as the highest-ranked player and one of the favourites to lift the title, despite recent injury troubles. Sinner's absence removes one of the Spaniard's biggest rivals and could ease his path as he bids for an eighth Grand Slam crown. The U.S. Open runs from August 23 to September 13.

item.title: Príncipe Harry e outros enfrentam conta milionária por ação judicial fracassada
item.description: O príncipe Harry, Elton John e outros demandantes de destaque podem ter que pagar milhões de dólares do próprio bolso para cobrir as despesas judiciais da editora do Daily Mail, depois que um juiz determinou que suas ações judiciais de violação de privacidade, que não tiveram sucesso, foram conduzidas de maneira não razoável.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O príncipe Harry, Elton John e outros demandantes de destaque podem ter que pagar milhões de dólares do próprio bolso para cobrir as despesas judiciais da editora do Daily Mail, depois que um juiz determinou que suas ações judiciais de violação de privacidade, que não tiveram sucesso, foram conduzidas de maneira não razoável. A decisão do juiz Matthew Nicklin sobre as custas, publicada na sexta-feira, também determinou um pagamento provisório de 9,54 milhões de libras por parte dos demandantes para cobrir as custas judiciais da Associated Newspapers. No mês passado, Nicklin rejeitou de forma abrangente o processo movido pelo filho mais novo do rei Charles, por Elton John e outras cinco personalidades, refutando as alegações de que os jornais do Mail tivessem se envolvido em atividades ilegais generalizadas, como a invasão de telefones. A decisão de sexta-feira representou um duro golpe para Harry e os demais ao determinar que o valor pendente deveria ser pago com base em “indenização”. Isso significa que, como parte perdedora, o príncipe e os demais devem arcar com as despesas da Associated sem que a editora precise comprovar que essas despesas foram razoáveis e proporcionais. Ao explicar sua decisão, Nicklin criticou duramente a forma como o caso dos autores da ação havia sido apresentado, observando, inclusive, que alegações graves baseavam-se em fundamentos "especulativos e dedutivos". "Em minha avaliação, o efeito cumulativo dessas questões coloca o caso muito além da normalidade. A conduta foi extremamente desarrazoada", afirmou Nicklin. Um porta-voz de Harry não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Um porta-voz da Associated Newspapers classificou a decisão como “mais uma vitória esmagadora para o Mail e seu jornalismo”. Foi informado ao tribunal, em uma audiência realizada em julho, que a Associated havia incorrido em despesas legais no valor de 34,5 milhões de libras (45,8 milhões de dólares), enquanto Harry e outros reclamantes contavam apenas com uma apólice de seguro que cobria 16 milhões de libras.

item.title: Bolivia removes economy minister after lawmaker pressure
item.description: Bolivia's government has named Oscar Mario Justiniano Pinto as interim Economy Minister, removing Jose Gabriel Espinoza from the post, according to a presidential decree published Friday in the Official Gazette.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bolivia's government has named Oscar Mario Justiniano Pinto as interim Economy Minister, removing Jose Gabriel Espinoza from the post, according to a presidential decree published Friday in the Official Gazette. The move comes days after Bolivia's Congress [USN:S0N42V04M TEXT:"voted to censure"] Espinoza, dealing a setback to President Rodrigo Paz's government amid mounting economic challenges. Espinoza said on Tuesday he would take legal action against the censure, which the government called unconstitutional, and turn to the nation's top constitutional tribunal to review the decision. Paz's administration initially said Espinoza would remain in office while the tribunal reviewed the dispute. Friday's decree established that Pinto, Bolivia's environment minister, will head the economy ministry until a permanent candidate is appointed. It did not provide a timeline. Espinoza's ouster comes at a sensitive time for Paz's government, which is seeking congressional backing for economic reforms and for a [USN:L6N443160 TEXT:"financing program"] negotiated with the International Monetary Fund in July that still requires approval from both Bolivia's Congress and the IMF Executive Board.

item.title: Euro zone consumer confidence rises to -15.5 in August
item.description: Euro zone consumer confidence rose by 0.4 points in August from the July number, figures released on Friday showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Euro zone consumer confidence rose by 0.4 points in August from the July number, figures released on Friday showed. The European Commission said a flash estimate showed euro zone consumer morale improved to -15.5 this month from -15.9 in July. Economists polled by Reuters had expected a fall to -16.3. In the European Union as a whole, consumer sentiment rose by 0.1 point to -15.0. For European Commission data click on: https://ec.europa.eu/info/business-economy-euro/indicators-statistics/economic-databases/business-and-consumer-surveys/latest-business-and-consumer-surveys_en#recent-press-releases

item.title: トランプ大統領、輸入牛ひき肉の関税一部緩和へ－選挙前に価格対策
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は、米国が輸入する一部の牛ひき肉について関税を軽減すると表明した。11月の中間選挙を前に、重要な懸案となっている米消費者の負担を和らげるため、価格引き下げを狙う。

トランプ氏は21日、ソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「本日、働く米国の家庭のために牛ひき肉の価格を大幅に引き下げる合意をまとめた」と述べた。同氏は「今後90日間、米国は牛ひき肉用の製品を最大30万トン、関税割当枠を超えた場合に課される関税なしで輸入することを認める。この牛肉を、現在の市場価格より25%安く販売するとの確約を得ている」と説明した。

トランプ氏は輸入元を含め、合意の詳細をそれ以上明らかにしなかった。ホワイトハウスは、コメント要請に今のところ回答していない。

中間選挙では、有権者が経済をどう評価するかが大きな争点となる可能性が高い。食料品、医療、光熱費、住宅のコスト上昇が特に注目されている。牛肉、卵、ガソリンといった生活必需品の価格は、消費者がインフレをどう感じるかに特に大きな影響を与える。

米労働統計局（BLS）の19日の発表によると、7月の牛ひき肉の平均小売価格は前月から横ばいで、小売業者や消費者が一段の値上げをこらえていることが示された。1ポンド（約450グラム）当たりの平均価格は7.116ドル（約1130円）。過去最高値になお近いものの、2025年7月からの上昇率は9.4%と、17カ月ぶりの小幅な伸びだった。

トランプ氏はこれまでも、米国の牛肉市場の供給問題を緩和して価格を引き下げるための措置を講じてきた。アルゼンチンなどから牛肉の輸入を増やしたほか、メキシコからの生体牛の輸入再開も検討している。

トランプ氏の経済運営やイラン戦争への対応、ガソリン価格の急騰などに有権者が不満を募らせる中、世論調査によると、議会の支配権維持を目指す共和党は厳しい戦いを強いられている。

item.title: El príncipe Enrique y otros famosos se enfrentan a factura multimillonaria por fallida demanda
item.description: El príncipe Enrique, Elton John y otros demandantes de alto perfil se enfrentan a tener que pagar millones de dólares para cubrir los costos judiciales de la editorial del Daily Mail, después de que un juez dictaminó que sus demandas por violación de la privacidad, que fueron desestimadas, se llevaron a cabo de forma irrazonable.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El príncipe Enrique, Elton John y otros demandantes de alto perfil se enfrentan a tener que pagar millones de dólares para cubrir los costos judiciales de la editorial del Daily Mail, después de que un juez dictaminó que sus demandas por violación de la privacidad, que fueron desestimadas, se llevaron a cabo de forma irrazonable. La sentencia del juez Matthew Nicklin sobre las costas, publicada el viernes, también ordenó a los demandantes un pago provisional de 9,54 millones de libras esterlinas para sufragar las costas judiciales de Associated Newspapers. El mes pasado, el juez desestimó la demanda presentada por el hijo menor del rey Carlos, el célebre cantante y otras cinco personalidades, rechazando las acusaciones de que las publicaciones del Mail se hubieran dedicado a actividades ilegales generalizadas, como las escuchas telefónicas. La sentencia supuso un duro golpe para Enrique y los demás al dictaminar que el importe pendiente debía pagarse "a título de indemnización". Esto significa que, como parte perdedora, el príncipe y los demás deben sufragar las costas de Associated sin que la editorial tenga que demostrar que estas eran razonables y proporcionadas. Al explicar su decisión, Nicklin se mostró muy crítico con la forma en que se había planteado el caso de los demandantes, señalando, entre otros aspectos, que las graves acusaciones se basaron en fundamentos "especulativos e inferenciales". "A mi juicio, el efecto acumulativo de estas cuestiones sitúa el caso muy fuera de lo habitual. La conducta fue irrazonable en gran medida", afirmó Nicklin. Un portavoz de Enrique no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Un portavoz de Associated Newspapers calificó la sentencia como "otra victoria aplastante para el Mail y su periodismo". En una vista celebrada en julio se informó al tribunal de que Associated había incurrido en unos gastos legales de 34,5 millones de libras (45,8 millones de dólares), mientras que Harry y los demás demandantes solo contaban con una póliza de seguro que cubría 16 millones de libras.

item.title: Asian shares advance despite Wall Street losses as U.S. Treasury’s moves fail to calm markets
item.description: Asian shares were mostly higher on Friday following a retreat on Wall Street as a U.S. Treasury Department plan to boost its government debt buybacks had only limited capacity to calm markets.
item.dc:creator: The Associated Press
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK — U.S. stocks are rising Friday and trimming their losses from what’s been a shaky week. The bond market, which has been the centre of Wall Street’s action, remains jumpy, but yields are not moving as much as earlier in the week and are helping to keep financial markets relatively calm. The S&P 500 rose 0.3 per cent and was on track for just its second gain in the six days since it set its all-time high last week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 250 points, or 0.5 per cent, as of 9:35 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 0.3 per cent higher. Ross Stores helped lead the way and climbed 3.8 per cent after reporting stronger profit and revenue for the latest quarter than analysts expected. CEO Jim Conroy said it saw both an increase in new customers and more interest from existing customers, while the off-price retailer at the same time benefited from refunds on tariffs. Most U.S. companies have reported bigger profits for the spring than analysts expected, which has helped drive the stock market’s run to records recently. Stock prices tend to follow the path of corporate profits over the long term. The other big lever that helps set stock prices is interest rates, which have been much shakier. After surging through the summer and then hesitating earlier this week following a surprise announcement by the U.S. Treasury Department that it will repurchase more longer-term bonds, yields held relatively steady in the bond market on Friday. The yield on the 10-year Treasury ticked up to 4.71 per cent from 4.69 per cent late Thursday. But it yo-yoed repeatedly between that level and 4.68 per cent in the overnight and early-morning hours. Contributing to the swings was continued uncertainty about when the war with Iran will allow oil tankers to freely exit the Persian Gulf again. That caused oil prices to move between gains and losses, which directly affected Treasury yields because higher prices raise worries about inflation. The price for a barrel of Brent crude oil added 0.4 per cent to US$94.09 after flipping repeatedly within a roughly US$2 band. One of the biggest beneficiaries of U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s move to increase the planned repurchases of Treasurys is bitcoin. Cryptocurrencies often rise when interest rates are lower and more money is flowing through the financial system. Bitcoin has climbed above US$76,500 from less than US$63,000 a week ago. That helped stocks in the crypto industry lead Wall Street. Robinhood Markets climbed 8.8 per cent, and Coinbase Global rose 7.8 per cent. In stock markets abroad, indexes rose in much of Asia and Europe. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng rose 1.2 per cent, and South Korea’s Kospi climbed 0.9 per cent for two of the world’s bigger moves. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Chan Ho-him and Michelle Chapman contributed to this report.

item.title: Apollo Global reveals data breach after hackers target financial firms
item.description: Asset manager Apollo Global Management suffered a data breach last month in which hackers stole some personal information, according to a letter on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Asset manager Apollo Global Management (APO.N) suffered a data breach last month in which hackers stole some personal information, according to a letter on Friday. The New York-based firm was among dozens of prominent U.S. financial institutions and other businesses that were recently targeted by ransom-seeking hackers who use phone calls to compromise their victims, Reuters [USN:L6N44406W TEXT:"reported earlier"] this month. Apollo said its investigation found there was unauthorized access to certain cloud platforms between July 6 and July 10. The firm notified law enforcement and engaged outside cybersecurity and forensic experts to investigate the breach. The company earlier this month learnt that the information potentially impacted by the data breach included names, dates of birth, contact information, home addresses, and social security numbers. Internet intelligence data reviewed by Reuters had shown that hackers devised websites aimed at stealing passwords from employees of private equity firms and financial companies. Low-tech tactics such as phone calls to target the financial industry still rank among the most effective ones despite the emergence of sophisticated security programs and AI-driven threats, according to experts. Apollo's investigation remains ongoing and the firm hasn't found evidence that stolen information has been publicly posted or used for identity theft or fraud at this time. Affected individuals whose information was stolen are being offered complimentary third-party identity protection and credit monitoring services by the firm, Apollo Global Head Of Human Capital Matthew Breitfelder said in the letter. Cybercriminals had built digital traps for hundreds of companies recently, including ride-hailing company Uber (UBER.N) and jeans brand Levi Strauss (LEVI.N) , Reuters reported earlier this month. [USN:L6N4480UG TEXT:"Uber Freight"] and [USN:L6N4440OL TEXT:"Levi Strauss"] earlier this month said they were investigating cybersecurity incidents involving unauthorized access to their systems.

item.title: Banco do Brasil anuncia parceria com iFood para ampliar financiamentos no Move Brasil Motos
item.description: O Banco do Brasil anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma parceria com o iFood para ampliar os financiamentos na linha Move Brasil Motos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Banco do Brasil (BBAS3.SA) anunciou nesta sexta-feira uma parceria com o iFood para ampliar os financiamentos na linha Move Brasil Motos. O acordo prevê a atuação conjunta das instituições na identificação de entregadores elegíveis ao programa, na integração de informações e na oferta ativa das soluções de financiamento, com ações direcionadas de comunicação e relacionamento. Em meados de agosto, o BB afirmou que desembolsou R$17,1 milhões em contratos na linha Move Brasil Entregadores e Motoapp, iniciada em 27 de julho. O programa contempla motociclistas e ciclistas que atuam em plataformas de transporte ou entrega há pelo menos 6 meses e que tenham realizado, no mínimo, 100 corridas ou entregas pelo iFood. A linha de crédito possibilita o financiamento de 100% do valor das motocicletas, motonetas, ciclomotores e bicicletas elétricas novas, com prazo de pagamento de até 48 meses, incluindo carência de dois meses. As taxas são de 0,90% ao mês para mulheres e 0,97% ao mês para homens.

item.title: Setor de serviços dos EUA impulsiona aceleração na atividade empresarial, mostra PMI
item.description: O crescimento mais forte do setor de serviços dos Estados Unidos em quase dois anos impulsionou uma forte aceleração na atividade empresarial geral em agosto, compensando a desaceleração da expansão no setor manufatureiro em meio à redução na formação de estoques e interrupções na oferta devido à guerra liderada pelos EUA contra o Irã.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O crescimento mais forte do setor de serviços dos Estados Unidos em quase dois anos impulsionou uma forte aceleração na atividade empresarial geral em agosto, compensando a desaceleração da expansão no setor manufatureiro em meio à redução na formação de estoques e interrupções na oferta devido à guerra liderada pelos EUA contra o Irã. As pesquisas Índice de Gerentes de Compras (PMI) publicadas pela S&P Global nesta sexta-feira sugerem que o crescimento econômico geral dos EUA está a caminho de dobrar a taxa de expansão anualizada de 1,5% registrada no segundo trimestre. A S&P Global informou que seu PMI preliminar do setor de serviços subiu para 56,8, nível mais alto desde dezembro de 2024, ante 54,6 em julho. O resultado impulsionou o PMI Composto preliminar para 56,0, máxima desde abril de 2022, ante 54,5 no mês passado. A força do setor de serviços mais do que compensou uma desaceleração no PMI de manufatura, que caiu de 53,9 em julho para 53,2, a menor marca em cinco meses. Valores acima de 50 indicam expansão da atividade. Economistas consultados pela Reuters projetavam que o PMI de serviços recuaria para 54,0 em comparação com o ritmo de julho, que foi impulsionado pelos gastos relacionados à Copa do Mundo e à comemoração do 250º aniversário do Dia da Independência dos EUA, dois fatores ausentes em agosto. As previsões apontavam para que o índice de manufatura se mantivesse em 53,9. “Os negócios nos EUA estão em franca expansão, com as empresas relatando o crescimento mais rápido da produção em mais de quatro anos até o momento no terceiro trimestre, à medida que a expansão ganhou ainda mais impulso em agosto”, afirmou Chris Williamson, economista-chefe de negócios da S&P Global Market Intelligence, em comunicado. “Os dados da pesquisa para o terceiro trimestre apontam atualmente para um crescimento anualizado próximo a 3,0%, um aumento sólido em relação ao ritmo de 1,5% observado no segundo trimestre.” (Reportagem de Dan Burns)

item.title: イラン大統領、戦況で優位な今こそ対米戦争終結を－国内強硬派に異議
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は、米国との戦争終結を訴えた。戦闘継続を主張する強硬派に改めて異議を唱えた格好だ。

「われわれに力と尊厳があり、世界全体がわれわれの勝利を認めている今こそ、戦争を終わらせる方がよい」との同氏発言をイラン学生通信（ISNA）が伝えた。

ペゼシュキアン氏は選挙によって選ばれたイラン最高位の指導者だが、権限は主に国内の経済政策に限られている。

21日の北海ブレント原油は、ペゼシュキアン氏の発言を受けて日中高値から一時下落したが、その後は持ち直し1バレル＝94ドル前後で取引されている。

ペゼシュキアン氏とアラグチ外相、交渉責任者を務めるイラン議会のガリバフ議長は、現在では事実上の崩壊に追い込まれた6月の停戦合意締結以降、外交を通じた戦争終結と経済再建を優先するよう訴えてきた。

だが、米イランの紛争が早期に決着する兆しは見えない。ベッセント米財務長官は、イランとその貿易相手国を経済的に孤立させる計画を24日に発表する見通しだ。

対立の長期化でイランのインフレは悪化し、通貨リアルは対ドルで過去最安値を更新している。

一方、強大な権限を持つイラン軍指導部の一部などからは、イラン側が優勢であり、戦闘を続けるべきだとの主張も出ている。

イランの革命防衛隊（IRGC）は「攻撃的ドクトリン」に転換しており、「敵の領土内」での作戦実行も視野に軍再編を行ったと、幹部が先週明らかにした。

原題：Iranian President Calls for End to US War While Tehran Is Ahead（抜粋）

--取材協力：Charles Gorrivan、Golnar Motevalli.

item.title: El Niño threat to Vietnam coffee crop should not be underestimated, official says
item.description: Vietnam’s 2026/27 robusta coffee crop could see a slight increase in output, though the threat posed by this year’s El Niño should not be underestimated, Thai Nhu Hiep, vice chairman of the Vietnam ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Vietnam’s 2026/27 robusta coffee crop could see a slight increase in output, though the threat posed by this year’s El Niño should not be underestimated, Thai Nhu Hiep, vice chairman of the Vietnam Coffee-Cocoa Association, told Reuters. The slight increase in output should come as areas replanted in recent years enter phases of more stable yields, Hiep, who is also chairman and CEO of Vietnamese coffee exporter Vinh Hiep Co., Ltd, said late on Thursday. Though he did not give a production forecast of his own, Hiep pointed to the U.S. Department of Agriculture, which expects Vietnamese coffee production of 32 million 60-kilogram bags in the 2026/27 crop, the overwhelming majority of which is robusta coffee. However, the threat from the El Niño weather phenomenon cannot be ignored, Hiep said, adding that Vietnam’s central highlands region is particularly vulnerable to extreme weather patterns during crucial parts of the crop cycle. “For Vietnam, adapting to climate change is no longer a future concern. It has become an urgent necessity to safeguard coffee production,” Hiep said while in Brazil for an international coffee event. Vietnam’s coffee industry is collaborating with farmers to develop a specialty robusta profile based on quality, helping the country’s beans gain recognition for their unique origins, he said. “We believe this approach will boost export value while enabling farmers to capture a larger share of the value generated throughout the coffee supply chain,” he said. The country is also building data infrastructure to help meet European Union rules on traceability intended to prevent deforestation caused by crops like coffee, Hiep said. Twice delayed due to its complexity, the EU Deforestation Regulation (EUDR) requires importers of commodities and related goods to prove their products weren’t grown on recently deforested land. “EUDR should not be viewed merely as a barrier to exports,” Hiep said. “It also presents an opportunity for Vietnam to build a coffee supply chain that is more transparent, sustainable, and competitive in the long run.” Reporting by Oliver Griffin; Editing by Kirsten Donovan

item.description: ［ワシントン ２１日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ワシントン　２１日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は２１日、米消費者が食料品価格の高騰に苦しむ中、価格引き下げを目指す９０日間の合意の一環として、牛ひき肉を最大３０万トンまで関税割当枠外で輸入することを認める方針を明らかにした。

トランプ氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で、牛肉が現在の市場価格より２５％安く販売されるという「確約」を得たと表明。ただ、牛肉の産地や、価格引き下げを確約した相手については明らかにしなかった。

トランプ氏は「この合意は国民のために物価を引き下げると同時に、偉大な米国の畜牛産業を再び成長させる余地を与えるだろう」と述べた。

ホワイトハウスの担当者は、合意の詳細に関するコメント要請にすぐには応じなかった。

item.title: US service sector fuels acceleration in business activity, S&P Global says
item.description: The strongest growth in the U.S. services sector in nearly two years powered a sharp acceleration in overall business activity in August, offsetting a slowing of growth in a manufacturing sector being restrained by reduced stock building and supply disruptions from the U.S.-led war with Iran.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The strongest growth in the U.S. services sector in nearly two years powered a sharp acceleration in overall business activity in August, offsetting a slowing of growth in a manufacturing sector being restrained by reduced stock building and supply disruptions from the U.S.-led war with Iran. The Purchasing Managers' Index surveys published by S&P Global on Friday suggest that nearly two-thirds of the way through the current third quarter, overall U.S. economic growth is on track to double the second quarter's 1.5% annualized expansion rate. S&P Global said its flash services Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 56.8, the highest since December 2024, from 54.6 in July and drove its Composite Output Index up to 56.0, the highest since April 2022, from 54.5 last month. The strength in services more than offset an easing in S&P's manufacturing PMI to a five-month low of 53.2 from 53.9 in July. Readings above 50 indicate expansion in activity. Economists polled by Reuters had expected the services PMI to ease to 54.0 from a July pace that was aided by spending around the FIFA World Cup and the 250th U.S. Independence Day celebration, a pair of drivers absent in August. Forecasts saw the manufacturing index holding steady at 53.9. "U.S. business is booming, with firms reporting the fastest output growth for over four years so far in the third quarter as the expansion picked up further momentum in August," Chris Williamson, chief business economist at S&P Global Market Intelligence, said in a statement. "The survey data for the third quarter are currently pointing to annualized growth approaching 3.0%, up solidly from the 1.5% pace seen in the second quarter." PRICE PRESSURES REMAIN ELEVATED New services business growth was the fastest since December 2024, allowing services hiring to grow by the most in 19 months. The factory side of the slate showed the continued strains of the Iran war , which has led to the effective closure of the vital Strait of Hormuz, disrupting the flow of key commodity supplies and sending energy prices higher. Order growth that had jumped after the war began nearly six months ago as companies sought to pad inventories slowed for a fourth straight month, and factory output growth was the weakest in 13 months. "As reduced safety stock building and supply delays dampen factory production growth, the service sector is now playing a key role in driving a sustained U.S. expansion, underscoring a dependency on consumer spending and financial services growth," Williamson said. The report showed inflation pressures receded somewhat, though growth rates for both input costs and selling prices remain elevated. The average cost increase so far in the third quarter is still slightly exceeding what was seen in the second quarter despite the easing in August, the report said. "Price pressures, while fading, also remain elevated and prone to renewed upward pressures should energy prices rise again," Williamson said.

item.title: Consumidores de EEUU ajustan presupuestos, pero siguen encontrando margen para caprichos y lujos
item.description: Las decepcionantes ventas de Walmart y el buen comportamiento de Home Depot entre los aficionados al "hazlo tú mismo" que cuidan su presupuesto indican que los consumidores estadounidenses de clase media se están volviendo cada vez más tacaños, mientras que los compradores con mayor poder adquisitivo siguen apoyando a marcas de lujo como Ralph Lauren.
item.dc:creator: Juveria Tabassum, Anuja Mistry
item.content:encoded: Las decepcionantes ventas de Walmart y el buen comportamiento de Home Depot entre los aficionados al "hazlo tú mismo" que cuidan su presupuesto indican que los consumidores estadounidenses de clase media se están volviendo cada vez más tacaños, mientras que los compradores con mayor poder adquisitivo siguen apoyando a marcas de lujo como Ralph Lauren. Los informes de resultados del último mes de una serie de supermercados, tiendas de bricolaje, restaurantes y marcas de lujo estadounidenses han puesto de manifiesto que los consumidores destinan la mayor parte de su gasto a productos básicos y posponen los grandes proyectos, aunque siguen dejando margen para pequeños caprichos asequibles y gastos excesivos ocasionales. Mientras que los compradores con mayor poder adquisitivo siguen adquiriendo pantalones cortos de lino de Ralph Lauren (RL.N) y productos de belleza de prestigio, los consumidores con ingresos más bajos están estirando sus presupuestos en Taco Bell y Ross Stores (ROST.O) , combinando menús económicos y ropa rebajada con compras de primera necesidad. El gasto total no se ha desplomado, pero "los hogares se están volviendo mucho más selectivos a la hora de decidir en qué gastan su dinero", afirmó Lale Akoner, estratega de mercados globales de eToro. En una época de precios elevados de la gasolina, se espera que esta tendencia se mantenga durante la importante temporada de compras navideñas. Es probable que los minoristas recurran a una combinación de descuentos, novedades y marcas de gama alta para seguir atrayendo a los clientes. "Cuando los precios del combustible suben y superan los 4 dólares, quizá eso tenga un impacto psicológico (…) los consumidores están haciendo concesiones", afirmó el jueves John David Rainey, presidente financiero de Walmart, después de que la empresa anunciara su crecimiento más lento en ventas en tiendas comparables en seis años, pese a haber rebajado los precios de 11.000 artículos. Es posible que los recortes de precios por sí solos ya no basten para convencer a un comprador reticente. En McDonald’s (MCD.N) , las opciones de menú con descuento de este trimestre, en un menú por lo demás caro, no lograron atraer a los clientes, que respondieron con mayor entusiasmo a los nuevos productos del menú en las tiendas de Yum Brands (YUM.N) , como Taco Bell, KFC y Pizza Hut. Walmart, TJX (propietaria de TJ Maxx) y Home Depot advirtieron esta semana que los compradores siguen siendo "selectivos", mientras que las ventas minoristas de Estados Unidos en julio registraron su primera caída en nueve meses. "La selectividad se aprecia en los aperitivos y las compras impulsivas, donde el comprador sigue dispuesto a pagar más por el artículo que vino a buscar y se salta el segundo", afirmó Joel Goldstein, presidente de Mr. Checkout Distributors. Empresas conocidas por ofrecer lujo asequible, como Tapestry (TPR.N) , Estee Lauder (EL.N) y Birkenstock (BIRK.N) , presentaron sólidos resultados gracias a la demanda de ropa, bolsos y fragancias con precios muy por encima de los 100 dólares. La cadena de cafeterías Starbucks (SBUX.O) logró recuperar las ventas de sus costosos cafés con leche, ya que los consumidores han valorado positivamente la mejora en los tiempos de servicio y un mejor ambiente en las tiendas. Para atender a ambos extremos del mercado, los minoristas están combinando rebajas de precios con la incorporación de marcas de gama alta a sus estanterías. Target, por ejemplo, está ampliando su marca propia de alimentación "Good & Gather", al tiempo que ofrece artículos de gama alta como los cochecitos Bugaboo. Además, ha fijado el precio de alrededor del 95% de sus artículos de vuelta al cole en niveles similares o inferiores a los del año pasado. Tanto Target como Walmart están destinando el dinero recibido de importantes devoluciones de aranceles a reducir los precios de productos básicos de la despensa, como la carne de vacuno, que se encareció durante el último año, en parte debido a los aranceles de importación. No obstante, los descuentos tienen sus límites. "Para los consumidores con mayor dificultad económica, la bajada de precios tiene un límite cuando los presupuestos familiares ya se encuentran bajo presión. La limitación radica cada vez más en la cantidad de renta disponible que les queda para gastar", afirmó Axel Rudolph, analista técnico jefe de IG Group. Incluso Walmart, que revisó al alza sus previsiones anuales, señaló que la temporada de compras de vuelta al colegio tuvo un buen comienzo gracias a la presencia de "marcas de gama más alta" y "artículos más caros" que atraen a un abanico más amplio de compradores. Una de las señales más evidentes de la cautela de los consumidores se puso de manifiesto en el tamaño de las cestas de la compra en Walmart y Target, donde los clientes siguieron acudiendo a las tiendas pero gastaron menos por visita. "Incluso Walmart, que se ha visto respaldada por los hogares más acomodados que han optado por productos más económicos, no es capaz de mantener al alza el crecimiento del gasto medio", afirmó Angeline Ong, de IG Group. Esa misma cautela está lastrando a las cadenas de bricolaje. Home Depot y Lowe's se beneficiaron de la demanda de mantenimiento y proyectos estacionales, pero el aumento de los costos de financiación hizo que los consumidores siguieran posponiendo las reformas de mayor envergadura que suelen requerir financiación. "El verdadero reto sería que también se produjera un descenso en la afluencia de clientes", señaló Brian Jacobsen, de Annex Wealth Management. "Eso podría ocurrir si no se produce un cierto alivio en los presupuestos debido al aumento de las tasas de interés y a los elevados precios de la gasolina".

item.title: Local mais quente da Europa afirma que mudanças climáticas estão transformando o dia a dia
item.description: Cinco anos depois de Floridia ter registrado a temperatura mais alta já marcada na Europa, os moradores afirmam que o calor extremo não é mais medido por recordes, mas pelo seu impacto na vida cotidiana, mantendo as pessoas em casa, reduzindo a interação social e ameaçando seus meios de subsistência.
item.dc:creator: Danilo Arnone, Giselda Vagnoni
item.content:encoded: Cinco anos depois de Floridia ter registrado a temperatura mais alta já marcada na Europa, os moradores afirmam que o calor extremo não é mais medido por recordes, mas pelo seu impacto na vida cotidiana, mantendo as pessoas em casa, reduzindo a interação social e ameaçando seus meios de subsistência. O recorde de 48,8 graus Celsius registrado em agosto de 2021 transformou a comuna siciliana em um símbolo do aquecimento climático na Europa, no momento em que o continente saía das restrições da Covid-19. Hoje, ondas de calor cada vez mais frequentes e prolongadas estão levando as pessoas a ficarem em casa, deixando ruas e praças desertas e levando alguns moradores a comparar o calor extremo a uma nova forma de lockdown. A mudança é visível em toda a localidade de 20 mil habitantes nos arredores de Siracusa, a antiga cidade grega na costa sudeste da Sicília. A Piazza del Popolo, há muito tempo o centro social de Floridia e repleta de cafés, palmeiras e prédios municipais, fica quase vazia durante grande parte do dia. O calor persiste até bem tarde da noite, atrapalhando uma tradição local muito apreciada, conhecida como “pigghiari u frescu”, quando as famílias colocam cadeiras da cozinha do lado de fora de suas casas para aproveitar a brisa e socializar. “É terrível porque muitas pessoas acabam ficando trancadas em casa. De certa forma, estamos todos passando por outro tipo de confinamento”, disse à Reuters a secretária de Cultura de Floridia, Serena Spada. “Até mesmo quem tem filhos pequenos se vê nessa situação. As crianças não podem ir ao parque nem brincar ao ar livre porque, até o final da tarde, as temperaturas são realmente insuportáveis.” ALERTA QUE NÃO PASSOU Em 11 de agosto de 2021, o Serviço de Informação Agrometeorológica da Sicília (SIAS) registrou uma temperatura de 48,8°C em Monasteri, um distrito rural a cerca de 5 km do centro de Floridia. Em 2024, a Organização Meteorológica Mundial certificou esse valor como a temperatura mais alta já registrada na Europa continental, um recorde que permanece até hoje. “Enquanto caminhava, comecei a ter dificuldade para respirar e pensei: ‘Eu poderia morrer aqui na rua, sem ninguém por perto para me ajudar’”, disse o morador Ugo Tomasello. Muitos moradores achavam que o recorde seria um evento isolado. Em vez disso, os verões quentes se tornaram a norma. “Acabou sendo um sinal de alerta muito triste”, afirmou a secretária de Cultura. Embora o recorde de temperatura tenha chamado a atenção internacional, cientistas climáticos afirmam que eventos extremos isolados são menos significativos do que o aumento constante das temperaturas médias. Dados do Reuters Climate Monitor mostraram que Floridia atingiu 33,3°C em 12 de agosto de 2026, 4,1°C acima da média da norma histórica de 1961 a 1990. “É realmente o aumento das temperaturas médias que nos preocupa”, disse o diretor do SIAS, Luigi Pasotti. “Não estamos mais falando de picos extremos de temperatura que duram um ou dois dias, como aconteceu em 2021. Estamos falando de semanas inteiras, até mesmo meses, durante os quais as temperaturas permanecem consistentemente altas.” As temperaturas noturnas também estão subindo, deixando pouco alívio do calor diurno. “Este ano, em particular, estamos registrando um número excepcionalmente alto de noites tropicais em algumas partes da Sicília, bem como de noites supertropicais”, declarou Pasotti. Em toda a Europa, as mudanças climáticas têm sido associadas a eventos climáticos extremos cada vez mais frequentes e intensos, desde secas e incêndios florestais até chuvas torrenciais. A Sicília emergiu como uma das linhas de frente climáticas da Europa. Para os apicultores de Floridia, o verão se tornou uma estação de ansiedade. “Há muito mais preocupação em superar o verão do que havia antes”, disse o apicultor Francesco Pappalardo, de 33 anos, que começou a trabalhar com seu pai ainda criança. “O calor pode causar o colapso de colônias individuais e, às vezes, apiários inteiros podem ser perdidos, como aconteceu comigo em anos anteriores.”

item.title: Irán promete respuesta "devastadora" ante amenaza de EEUU de cortar fuentes de sustento económico
item.description: Irán afirmó el viernes que su respuesta a cualquier nueva amenaza de Estados Unidos sería "devastadora", después de que Washington se comprometiera a imponer las sanciones financieras más duras de la historia con el objetivo de derrocar a los dirigentes iraníes.
item.dc:creator: Jana Choukeir, Eman Abouhassira, Susan Heavey
item.content:encoded: Irán afirmó el viernes que su respuesta a cualquier nueva amenaza de Estados Unidos sería "devastadora", después de que Washington se comprometiera a imponer las sanciones financieras más duras de la historia con el objetivo de derrocar a los dirigentes iraníes. Washington se preparó para las sanciones que el secretario del Tesoro de EE. UU., Scott Bessent, dijo que detallaría el lunes. El presidente Donald Trump había advertido anteriormente de las consecuencias económicas que sufriría cualquier país que proporcionara "cualquier tipo de ayuda vital a Irán". El jefe del Estado Mayor de las Fuerzas Armadas de Irán, el general de división Ali Abdollahi, afirmó que la reacción de la República Islámica sería amplia y decisiva. "Con preparativos en tierra, mar, aire, defensa aérea y ciberespacio, las Fuerzas Armadas de Irán responderán a las nuevas amenazas del enemigo con respuestas aplastantes, punitivas y devastadoras", declaró Abdollahi, según recogen los medios iraníes. El presidente del Parlamento iraní, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, principal negociador del país en las conversaciones mediadas con Estados Unidos, afirmó que Washington parecía haber llegado a la conclusión de que no podría imponerse en una confrontación militar directa. "Debemos elaborar planes para hacer frente a las sanciones injustas, de modo que podamos superarlas", declaró en el vecino Irak, acusando a Estados Unidos e Israel de recurrir a lo que calificó de guerra económica y "cognitiva". BESSENT AFIRMA QUE MEDIDAS NO DEBERÍAN HACER SUBIR EL PRECIO DEL PETRÓLEO Los precios del petróleo bajaron ligeramente el viernes, pero se encaminaban hacia una segunda subida semanal tras el repunte registrado el jueves a raíz de la nueva amenaza de sanciones por parte de EE. UU. "No estoy seguro de por qué el petróleo ha subido a raíz de esto", declaró Bessent a la CNBC. "Si estamos ejerciendo la máxima presión económica, eso significa que probablemente no habrá una reanudación cinética a gran escala", afirmó, utilizando un término que hace referencia a la fuerza militar. Miles de personas han perdido la vida en la guerra, que ha arrastrado a los países del Golfo y ha elevado los precios mundiales del combustible, ya que Irán ha atacado el tráfico marítimo a través del estrecho de Ormuz, por donde antes de febrero circulaba aproximadamente una quinta parte de todo el petróleo comercializado. El jueves solo siete buques de mercancías navegaron por el estrecho de Ormuz, la mitad de la cifra del día anterior, según datos de la empresa de seguimiento marítimo Kpler, en comparación con los más de 130 que lo hacían al día antes de la guerra. Estados Unidos e Irán han anunciado en dos ocasiones acuerdos de alto el fuego, en abril y en junio, con el objetivo de restablecer la libre circulación de buques por el estrecho de Ormuz como paso previo para poner fin al conflicto, que ya dura casi seis meses, pero ambos acuerdos se desmoronaron rápidamente. Bessent declaró a la CNBC que «hablaría exactamente de lo que vamos a hacer» con respecto a Irán en una rueda de prensa el lunes. "Vamos a derrumbar este régimen. Es hora de que nuestros aliados y el resto del mundo tomen una decisión", afirmó, al describir el bloqueo naval reimpuesto a Irán en julio y las "sanciones más duras de la historia" como un "doble golpe". Irán ha soportado sanciones económicas casi continuas durante casi 50 años, desde la Revolución Islámica de 1979, pero su población sufre una elevada inflación, una moneda que se debilita y escasez de energía, además de una infraestructura dañada. Algunos iraníes entrevistados por Reuters han señalado que un mayor castigo económico podría agravar las penurias, debilitar a la clase clerical y provocar disturbios, aunque no ha habido indicios de ello desde la sangrienta represión de las protestas en enero. Antes de que Bessent tomara la palabra, el Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Irán afirmó que las sanciones estadounidenses no «provocarán ni la más mínima vacilación en la determinación de los iraníes de salvaguardar la independencia, la dignidad y la soberanía nacional de Irán». El presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, un político relativamente moderado que ha expresado su preocupación por la economía, afirmó que la respuesta de Irán a un ataque sería "aplastante", pero que la guerra debería terminar ahora que Estados Unidos se encuentra aislado internacionalmente, reiterando así una postura anterior. ÚLTIMO BLOQUEO EEUU EMPIEZA A REDUCIR LOS FLUJOS DE PETRÓLEO HACIA CHINA Trump se ve presionado para poner fin a la guerra, ya que los elevados precios del combustible están lastrando sus índices de popularidad y podrían poner en peligro el control del Congreso por parte de su Partido Republicano en las elecciones de mitad de legislatura de noviembre. Bessent señaló que China obtiene la mitad de su energía del Golfo, por lo que tendría sentido que se "sumara al plan". China compra más del 80 % del petróleo exportado por Irán, según datos de 2025 de la empresa de análisis Kpler, pero una mayor guerra económica de EE. UU. contra Pekín —que ha suavizado las restricciones anteriores sobre las exportaciones de sus minerales de tierras raras, de vital importancia— corre el riesgo de provocar represalias. Las ofertas de crudo iraní a los compradores chinos ya han disminuido desde que EE. UU. reimpuso su bloqueo a los puertos iraníes a mediados de julio, según informaron fuentes del sector a Reuters. La embajada de China en Washington afirmó que "las sanciones y la presión no ayudan a resolver el problema" y abogó por la vía diplomática. El endurecimiento de las sanciones conlleva otros riesgos, especialmente para los aliados de Estados Unidos en el Golfo, algunas de cuyas instalaciones energéticas y plantas desalinizadoras —de las que dependen para obtener agua potable— han sido objeto de ataques iraníes.

item.title: After getting rocked in his last start, Cubs' Matthew Boyd set to face M's
item.description: If not for St. Louis Cardinals slugger Joshua Baez, Matthew Boyd would be having a heckuva second half of the season.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: If not for St. Louis Cardinals slugger Joshua Baez, Matthew Boyd would be having a heckuva second half of the season. The Chicago Cubs veteran left-hander is scheduled to start in his home state Friday night in the opener of a three-game interleague series against the host Seattle Mariners. Boyd was on the wrong side of history last Saturday at Wrigley Field. He gave up three homers to Baez, a record for a hitter in his major league debut. "He just, he got the better of me," Boyd said. "He's a good player. There's a reason why he's called up. I know he had some recognition coming up, too, in terms of his status and whatnot. And he's had a great year and hit a lot of home runs in Triple-A. I mean, he's talented. He's a good hitter. "My mentality, you don't attack anybody any differently." The loss was the first for Boyd (8-2, 4.02 ERA) since his opening start of the season, March 26 against visiting Washington. In between those two starts, Boyd was 8-0 with a 2.96 ERA. Boyd, who was born in the Seattle suburb of Mercer Island and starred at Oregon State, made 10 relief appearances for the Mariners in 2022, going 2-0 with a 1.35 ERA. He's 2-2 with a 4.62 ERA in eight career appearances against Seattle, including seven starts. He has a 2.29 ERA without a decision in seven games (two starts) at T-Mobile Park. The Cubs have gone 12-6 this month and are five games behind first-place Milwaukee in the National League Central. Chicago has a six-game cushion atop the NL wild-card standings. Pete Crow-Armstrong secured his second straight season of 30 homers and 30 stolen bases Monday, when he homered leading off the game and added a walk-off shot against the crosstown rival White Sox. He also went deep in the first inning the next night. "He's having an insane season," teammate Alex Bregman said. "It's pretty crazy what he's doing. ... He's been electric for us all year. Unbelievable." While the Cubs had Thursday off after winning two of three games vs. the White Sox, the Mariners lost 7-4 at Milwaukee to cap a nine-game trip on which they went 4-5 while making stops in New York to face the Yankees and in Houston to meet the Astros. Seattle was outscored 65-38 on the trip, though that included a 22-0 defeat Tuesday to the Brewers. The Mariners took two of three games against the Astros to stay in both the American League West and wild-card races. They couldn't overcome the Brewers on Thursday after Seattle's George Kirby allowed six runs in the first inning. "I just wish I could have given the team a better chance from the get-go," he said. "A lot of things that are getting put in play right now are just finding ways to get through. So, just got to do a better job keeping guys off-balance and getting swing-and-miss." The Mariners are scheduled to send right-hander Emerson Hancock (7-7, 3.30 ERA) to the mound Friday before calling up phenom Kade Anderson for his MLB debut Saturday. Hancock snapped a string of three straight losses with a 10-5 victory last Saturday at Houston in a game in which he gave up two runs on five hits over seven innings, with eight strikeouts. He's 0-2 with a 9.90 ERA in two career starts against the Cubs. --Field Level Media

item.title: Fabricante chinesa de chips de memória flash YMTC planeja levantar US$4,9 bi IPO em Xangai
item.description: O pedido da fabricante chinesa de chips Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp (YMTC) para listar suas ações em Xangai foi aceito pela bolsa de valores do centro financeiro, segundo documentos divulgados nesta sexta-feira
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O pedido da fabricante chinesa de chips Yangtze Memory Technologies Corp (YMTC) para listar suas ações em Xangai foi aceito pela bolsa de valores do centro financeiro, segundo documentos divulgados nesta sexta-feira A medida abre caminho para uma oferta de ações no valor de 33 bilhões de iuanes (US$4,9 bilhões) no STAR Market de Xangai, semelhante à Nasdaq, o que a colocaria entre as maiores ofertas já realizadas no mercado, informou a bolsa. A listagem segue-se a recentes ofertas públicas de grande sucesso realizadas por outras empresas líderes do setor de tecnologia chinês, incluindo a fabricante de chips de memória ChangXin Memory Technologies, ou CXMT, e a empresa de robótica Unitree. (Reportagem de Yukun Zhang, Shi Bu e Ryan Woo)

item.title: Canada retail sales rise 0.6% in June, StatsCan says
item.description: Canada's retail sales rose 0.6% in June, beating an average analyst expectation of 0.4%, as sales jumped at clothing and general merchandise stores, data showed on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Promit Mukherjee
item.content:encoded: Canada's retail sales rose 0.6% in June, beating an average analyst expectation of 0.4%, as sales jumped at clothing and general merchandise stores, data showed on Friday. Retail sales, which include purchases of cars, furniture, food and gasoline, are considered an early indicator of gross domestic product growth and account for about 40% of consumer spending. Sales rose to C$74.28 billion ($54.08 billion) in June from C$73.84 billion in the prior month, Statistics Canada said. However sales are likely to decrease by 0.8% in July, the federal statistics agency said in an advance estimate. June sales increased across seven out of nine subsectors. In volume terms, retail sales increased 1.5% in June. The biggest increases were recorded in the clothing, clothing accessories, shoes, jewelry, luggage and leather goods retailers category, which posted a jump of 3.1%, although its sales numbers contributed only 5.6% to the overall sales figure. Among big-ticket items, sales at general merchandise retailers, which account for more than 15% of total retail sales, surged by 2.7%, StatsCan said. Sales at motor vehicle and parts dealers, the largest subsector and accounting for roughly 27% of retail sales, rose 1%, following a 0.7% increase in May. This was its third consecutive monthly increase. Purchases at food and beverage retailers, the second-biggest category, dropped 0.4% as consumers shopped less at supermarket and grocery retailers, data showed. The largest decrease was observed at gasoline stations and fuel vendors (-4.1%), which posted their first decline in four months, primarily due to lower gasoline prices. "Through the monthly volatility we still see a gradual improvement in consumer spending, which should continue into next year, supported by expanded household benefits and an improving labor market," said Andrew Grantham, senior economist at CIBC Capital Markets. ($1 = 1.3736 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Appeals court upholds block on DOJ subpoenas to NY AG James' office
item.description: A U.S. appeals court on Friday upheld a lower court's decision to block subpoenas to New York Attorney General Letitia James' office seeking information about cases she had pursued, dealing another setback to the Justice Department's efforts to investigate the longtime foe of President Donald Trump.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: A U.S. appeals court on Friday upheld a lower court's decision to block subpoenas to New York Attorney General Letitia James' office seeking information about cases she had pursued, dealing another setback to the Justice Department's efforts to investigate the longtime foe of President Donald Trump . The case stems from [USN:L6N3Y914E TEXT:"subpoenas"] that the top federal prosecutor in Albany, Trump ally John Sarcone, issued to James' office in August 2025 seeking records about civil lawsuits James filed against Trump and his family business and against the National Rifle Association gun rights group. Both Trump and the NRA were found liable following trials in each case. They claimed they were targeted for political purposes. The subpoenas were part of a criminal investigation into potential civil rights violations associated with those cases, Reuters reported at the time. No charges have so far been filed.

item.title: Presidente boliviano Paz despide a ministro de Economía Espinoza
item.description: El presidente boliviano, Rodrigo Paz, despidió el viernes al ministro de Economía, José Espinoza, según un decreto oficial en el que se designó al actual funcionario Oscar Justiniano Pinto como ministro interino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente boliviano, Rodrigo Paz, despidió el viernes al ministro de Economía, José Espinoza, según un decreto oficial en el que se designó al actual funcionario Oscar Justiniano Pinto como ministro interino. El despido llega días después de que la Asamblea Legislativa aprobara una [USN:L6N44F17L TEXT:"moción de censura"] contra Espinoza tras no comparecer ante el Congreso para responder preguntas sobre su gestión de la economía, la política monetaria y la planificación macroeconómica. La salida de Espinoza se produce en un momento difícil para el Gobierno de Paz, que busca apoyo del Congreso para impulsar reformas económicas y un programa de financiamiento negociado con el [USN:L1N43V0VN TEXT:"Fondo Monetario Internacional"] (FMI) en julio. Este programa es considerado clave para estabilizar la economía del país andino y aliviar la persistente escasez de combustible y divisas. Paz designó a Pinto, hasta ahora ministro de Producción Sostenible, Medio Ambiente y Agua, al frente de Economía de forma interina hasta el nombramiento de un sucesor definitivo.

item.title: Ghana midfielder Partey joins Al-Shabab
item.description: Ghana midfielder Thomas Partey has signed a one-year deal with Saudi Pro League side Al-Shabab, the club said on Friday, after leaving Villarreal at the end of his contract last season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ghana midfielder Thomas Partey has signed a one-year deal with Saudi Pro League side Al-Shabab, the club said on Friday, after leaving Villarreal at the end of his contract last season. Partey faces seven charges of rape and two of sexual assault in Britain, allegations he has denied. He [USN:L5N3V40E3 TEXT:"pleaded not guilty"] to charges of rape and sexual assault involving three women. The 33-year-old [USN:L6N42K11Y TEXT:"could not take part"] in Ghana's World Cup game against Panama in June after his visa application to enter Canada was refused. Under Canadian law, foreign nationals can be found inadmissible without a foreign conviction. Partey made 32 appearances for LaLiga side Villarreal last season but the club opted not to renew his contract.

item.title: Várias pessoas ficam feridas em ataque com espada a escola sueca, segundo município
item.description: Várias pessoas ficaram feridas na sexta-feira em uma escola sueca por uma pessoa armada com uma espada, informou o município de Fagersta, na região central da Suécia, em comunicado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Várias pessoas ficaram feridas na sexta-feira em uma escola sueca por uma pessoa armada com uma espada, informou o município de Fagersta, na região central da Suécia, em comunicado. “Foi recebida uma chamada sobre um caso de violência letal em andamento em uma escola em Fagersta. A polícia compareceu ao local e uma pessoa foi detida”, informou a polícia em comunicado. “A polícia continua atuando no local com diversos recursos. Solicita-se à população que respeite os bloqueios nas vias e siga as instruções da polícia.”

item.title: LG Electronics sees India emerging as key manufacturing and export hub
item.description: India products to over 50 countries and has invested Rs 5,000 crore in its Sri City factory, which will also serve as an export hub ...
item.dc:creator: Sharleen Dsouza
item.content:encoded: At its first annual general meeting (AGM) after listing, LG Electronics India told shareholders that the country is increasingly becoming an important manufacturing and export hub.  “We already serve over 50 countries through Made in India export, and by calendar year 2026, we are targeting 22 countries for Essential series export. We have also invested ₹5,000 crore in our Sri City factory,” said Sanjay Chitkara, co-chief sales & marketing officer at LG Electronics India.  The Sri City factory, which will also serve as an export hub, will begin operations by December.  He added that the strategy is to export premium products to advanced markets and expand its Essential series of products to emerging markets.  “Our ‘Make in India’ or the world strategy is an increasingly important growth lever for LG India,” Chitkara said.  The company's management said that it monitors global developments closely and acts in time. It also continues to add new geographies to reduce its dependency on any one market, it said.  The consumer and home electronics major will focus on innovation, operational excellence, sustainable growth and long-term value-creation, Daehyun Song, chairman of LG Electronics India, said at the AGM.  “Going forward, our focus will remain on innovation, operational excellence, sustainable growth, and long-term value creation. The company's listing during the year has also been an important milestone. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of corporate governance, transparency, and accountability expected from a listed company,” Song said. LG Electronics India has maintained a leading position in most product categories, said Managing Director Hong Ju Jeon, while answering shareholders’ questions. The company’s strength is based on three key areas; innovation, customer experience and partnerships with its channel partners.  “The penetration of home appliances in India is still relatively low. This means there is significant room for future growth. Today, refrigerator penetration is 30 per cent, washing machines is 20 per cent and room air conditioners is 10 per cent. We also expect further demand growth following the GST (goods and services tax) rate reduction for air conditioners and larger TVs. In simple terms, we see strong growth potential for LG Electronics in India,” Jeon said.  The management said that it is using artificial intelligence (AI) to optimise how appliances operate and reduce energy consumption.

item.title: Maresca unfazed by City exits ahead of season-opener against Bournemouth
item.description: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca said he was comfortable with his squad despite uncertainty over several players' futures, adding that the club was prepared for further movement before the transfer window closes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca said he was comfortable with his squad despite uncertainty over several players' futures, adding that the club was prepared for further movement before the transfer window closes. City host Bournemouth in their Premier League opener on Sunday after a [USN:L6N44D052 TEXT:"3-0 defeat by Arsenal"] in last week’s Community Shield. The departure of key midfielder Rodri to Barcelona and the expected exit of winger Savinho, who has been strongly linked with Tottenham Hotspur, have fuelled speculation over City's transfer plans. Egyptian forward Omar Marmoush has also been linked with a move away. Maresca said Rodri and Savinho had made clear that they wanted to leave, but described Marmoush’s position as different. "When the player wants to leave, then it is complicated to convince them to stay," Maresca told reporters on Friday. "It happened with Rodri and the same thing is happening with Savinho. Since day one he has come in and said he wanted to leave, so now we are waiting. "Omar is still here, still with us. He is different to Savinho, so we will see what happens." The Italian suggested a lack of playing time had been a factor behind several players seeking moves away from the Etihad Stadium. "Unless Rodri, the rest all have in common one thing, they didn't play a lot," he said. "When they don't play they prefer to leave." With less than two weeks remaining before the transfer deadline, Maresca said City were working closely with club officials on potential additions. He declined to discuss specific targets or say how many players the club might sign. City have been linked in media reports with Lille midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi and Chelsea's Argentina international Enzo Fernandez. "I am not worried about our squad. Since day one we have been working with the club and many things can happen in the last 10 days of the transfer window," Maresca said. "We know exactly what we need and then we will see over the next 10 days." Maresca also refused to comment on Fernandez, saying he did not believe it was appropriate to discuss players under contract elsewhere. "Enzo is a Chelsea player, and I'm not going to talk about players that are not with us," he said. "First of all because I think it's a lack of respect, and second because I don't like when different managers talk about our players." Maresca confirmed that winger Jeremy Doku would miss Sunday’s match after suffering a calf injury against Arsenal. Midfielder Matheus Nunes has returned to fitness, while the rest of the squad is available.

item.title: US, Canadian trade teams to meet again as tariffs deadline looms
item.description: Top trade negotiators from Canada and the U.S. will meet for the third day running in Washington on Friday to try to finalize a trade deal before threatened new American tariffs come into effect on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Greg Savoy
item.content:encoded: Top trade negotiators from Canada and the U.S. will meet for the third day running in Washington on Friday to try to finalize a trade deal before threatened new American tariffs come into effect on Saturday. A deal could mark a detente in what has been 18 months of tense relations that started when President Donald Trump imposed tariffs on key imports from Canada, prompting Ottawa to retaliate with a suite of counter measures. Trump says he will impose a new 50% tariff on about $20 billion worth of Canadian goods at 12:01 a.m. EDT (0401 GMT) on Saturday if a deal is not reached. Canada's minister responsible for trade with the U.S., Dominic LeBlanc, is due to meet U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer at 11:30 a.m. EDT (1530 GMT), LeBlanc's office said in a statement. LeBlanc met Greer for more than three [USN:L6N44H0RT TEXT:"hours"] on Thursday and said the two sides were "very close" to a deal, but added that more work was necessary. Even if a deal is reached, Prime Minister Mark Carney could find it hard to sell it to Canadians and the influential premiers of the 10 provinces. A Leger opinion poll showed on Wednesday that 56% of Canadians want Carney to make no further concessions. Sources say an agreement is expected to cut the top-line tariff on Canadian-built vehicles to 15% from 25% and halve tariffs on Canadian steel and aluminum to 25%. Ontario, a major steel and aluminum producer, wants the tariffs scrapped. Carney is calling on major provinces to rescind their ban on sales of U.S. alcohol, which is a major irritant for Washington. Wab Kinew, the premier of Manitoba, on Thursday said Trump was "very weak" and Canada should take advantage. "I think we've got the upper hand - they're back on their heels right now. They're coming to us for a deal, and so I think we should fight," he told reporters. Canada, though, is a tenth the size of the United States and sends around 70% of all exports south of the border, which makes it uniquely vulnerable to punitive U.S. trade actions. U.S. Vice President JD Vance on Wednesday mocked Carney, saying he "comes in and puffs his chest out and says, 'I’m going to, like, out-tough Donald Trump'." In a recording obtained by the Canadian Press, Vance can then be heard saying "It's hilarious because Carney presents this as some victory for Canada when fundamentally, like, they climb down on a lot of issues". Vance was speaking at a fundraiser in Southampton, New York.

item.title: Uber écope d'une amende de €825 mlns aux Pays-Bas pour la suspension automatisée de chauffeurs - document
item.description: L'Autorité néerlandaise de protection des données (AP) a décidé d'infliger à Uber une amende de 825 millions d’euros pour avoir désactivé des comptes de chauffeurs via des systèmes automatisés sans les en informer correctement, selon une décision du 17 août examinée par Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'Autorité néerlandaise de protection des données (AP) a décidé d'infliger à Uber (UBER.N) une amende de 825 millions d’euros pour avoir désactivé des comptes de chauffeurs via des systèmes automatisés sans les en informer correctement, selon une décision du 17 août examinée par Reuters. Il s’agit de la deuxième plus importante sanction jamais infligée au titre du règlement général sur la protection des données (RGPD), derrière l’amende de 1,2 milliard d’euros infligée à Meta (META.O) par l’Irlande en 2023 pour avoir transféré illégalement aux États-Unis les données d’utilisateurs européens de Facebook, une décision dont Meta a fait appel. Uber a déclaré avoir également l'intention de faire appel. "Nous sommes en profond désaccord avec cette décision et cette amende disproportionnée", a déclaré un porte-parole, affirmant garantir des contrôles humains ainsi que le droit de contester les suspensions. L’AP a confirmé cette décision, sans fournir immédiatement d’autres commentaires. Le RGPD interdit les décisions automatisées ayant un impact important sur la vie des personnes, exigeant un contrôle humain et la possibilité de les contester. "L’AP a conclu qu’Uber avait violé les droits des chauffeurs, en particulier le droit de ne pas faire l'objet d'une prise de décision automatisée ayant (...) des conséquences significatives", indique le document. "Uber a également violé le droit à l’information", précise la décision, indiquant que l’agence considérait qu’il s’agissait d’une infraction grave justifiant cette amende élevée. L’affaire porte sur des incidents survenus en Europe entre 2020 et 2022, à la suite d’une plainte déposée en France. Elle a été traitée par le régulateur néerlandais, car le siège européen d'Uber se trouve aux Pays-Bas. Uber a temporairement suspendu certains chauffeurs soupçonnés de fraude, notamment lorsque ses systèmes détectaient des détours inutiles visant à gonfler le prix des courses ou des courses acceptées sans intention de les effectuer. Uber affirme ne pas avoir désactivé définitivement ces comptes sans examen humain. Les chauffeurs ayant de faibles notes attribuées par les clients ont parfois été suspendus de manière définitive. Uber a déclaré ne plus prendre de décisions de désactivation définitive en se basant uniquement sur des systèmes automatisés.

item.title: Rockies, with moving parts at pitcher, open home series with Guardians
item.description: The Colorado Rockies returned from a 5-4 road trip with some momentum, but the Los Angeles Dodgers swept that away this week.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Colorado Rockies returned from a 5-4 road trip with some momentum, but the Los Angeles Dodgers swept that away this week. After an 0-3 start to their homestand, the Rockies will open a three-game series against the Cleveland Guardians on Friday night in Denver. Colorado right-hander Tanner Gordon (0-3, 5.55 ERA) will look for his first win of the season as Cleveland counters with left-hander Joey Cantillo (9-7, 3.80). Gordon will make his first start since just before the All-Star break and his sixth of the season. He has worked out of the bullpen 12 times this year and suffered two of his three losses as a starter, posting a 6.26 ERA in those outings. He has given up six homers in 23 innings as a starter. Gordon lost his only career appearance against the Guardians when he allowed seven runs (six earned) on eight hits in three innings of a 10-4 road defeat on July 29, 2025. He figures to get more starting opportunities after Michael Lorenzen was designated for assignment this week and veteran left-hander Kyle Freeland left a 6-4, 10-inning loss to the Dodgers on Wednesday with neck tightness in the fourth inning. Also likely to see action against the Guardians is rookie Mark Manfredi, who made his major league debut in relief of Freeland. The left-hander will always remember the first batter he faced -- superstar Shohei Ohtani, who walked. Andy Pages followed with a single, but Teoscar Hernandez lined out to left to end the inning. Manfredi pitched a perfect fifth inning, striking out two batters. "When I saw the injury and (Freeland) was walking off, I was, like, 'This is 100% going to be me,'" said Manfredi, who was acquired from Milwaukee at the trade deadline this month for reliever Antonio Senzatela. Colorado manager Warren Schaeffer said he liked what he saw from Manfredi's first outing. "I thought he threw the ball exceptionally well," Schaeffer said. "Got his first couple of punchouts." Cantillo, in his third season, will make his first career appearance against the Rockies. In three starts in August, he is 1-1 with a 3.00 ERA. Cleveland, despite a 62-66 record, is in the thick of both the American League Central race and the chase for the league's third wild-card spot. The Guardians took two of three games from San Francisco this week, including a 5-2 win Thursday afternoon, to finish their homestand at 3-3. Cleveland trails the first-place Chicago White Sox by 4 1/2 games in the Central and is only one game out of the final wild-card position. Friday night will begin a six-game road trip, and outfielder Jo Adell will make his first trip to Denver with the Guardians. Adell suffered a knee contusion in an 8-1 win over the Giants on Tuesday, sat out on Wednesday, and came into the Thursday game as a pinch hitter and remained in as the designated hitter. Cleveland acquired Adell from the Los Angeles Angels on Aug. 3 to add right-handed power to its lineup. He has three of his 19 home runs in 14 games with the Guardians, including one Tuesday before leaving that game. He likely will see more time at DH as his knee improves. "I'm just really excited about being here and being able to have a bit of a plan that I've been able to get at the plate with these guys," Adell said before the game on Thursday. "I'm excited for more. We've yet to play our best baseball, but it's on its way, so I'm excited." --Field Level Media

item.title: Ataque con espada deja varios heridos en un colegio sueco: autoridades
item.description: Varias personas resultaron heridas el viernes en un colegio a manos de una persona armada con una espada, según informó en un comunicado el municipio de Fagersta, en el centro de Suecia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Varias personas resultaron heridas el viernes en un colegio a manos de una persona armada con una espada, según informó en un comunicado el municipio de Fagersta, en el centro de Suecia. "Se recibió una llamada sobre un caso de violencia mortal en curso en un colegio de Fagersta. La policía acudió al lugar y detuvo a una persona", indicó la policía en un comunicado. "La policía sigue trabajando en el lugar de los hechos con diversos recursos. Se insta a la ciudadanía a respetar los controles de carretera y a seguir las instrucciones de la policía", agregó.

item.title: Versenkte Türgriffe - China ruft Millionen Autos wegen Sicherheitsbedenken zurück
item.description: In China müssen mehrere Millionen Autos von Herstellern wie Tesla oder Xiaomi wegen Sicherheitsbedenken bei ihren elektronischen Türgriffen nachgebessert werden. Dabei geht es in den meisten Fällen darum, dass der mechanische Notfallgriff bei einem Unfall schwer zu finden und zu bedienen ist. Tesla alleine rufe fast drei Millionen Fahrzeuge der Typen Model 3, Model Y, Model S und Model X zurück, teilte die zuständige Aufsicht am Freitag mit.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: In China müssen mehrere Millionen Autos von Herstellern wie Tesla (TSLA.O) oder Xiaomi (1810.HK) wegen Sicherheitsbedenken bei ihren elektronischen Türgriffen nachgebessert werden. Dabei geht es in den meisten Fällen darum, dass der mechanische Notfallgriff bei einem Unfall schwer zu finden und zu bedienen ist. Tesla alleine rufe fast drei Millionen Fahrzeuge der Typen Model 3, Model Y, Model S und Model X zurück, teilte die zuständige Aufsicht am Freitag mit. Der US-Autobauer erklärte, die mechanische Entriegelung könnte bei einem Ausfall des elektronischen Systems schwer zu finden sein und die Rettung der Passagiere erschweren. Zur Abhilfe werde ein Warnhinweis angebracht, dazu komme ein Softwareupdate. Neben Tesla sind auch die Hersteller Xiaomi, Leapmotor, Xpeng, Zeekr und Lynk & Co von dem Rückruf betroffen. In China sind versenkbare Türgriffe ab 2027 verboten. Die Volksrepublik ist damit das erste Land, das gegen das Design vorgeht, das durch Tesla eingeführt und von vielen Elektroautobauern nachgeahmt wurde. Die Technik war nach mehreren tödlichen Unfällen in die Kritik geraten.
