item.title: Man armed with sword injures several people at Swedish high school
item.description: A man armed with a sword injured several people at a Swedish high school on Friday and one person was later detained, local authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Johan Ahlander
item.content:encoded: A man armed with a sword injured several people at a Swedish high school on Friday and one person was later detained, local authorities said. The incident occurred on Friday afternoon at the Brinell high school, which has some 450 students aged 16 to 20, in the town of Fagersta in central Sweden. "A call was received regarding a case of ongoing deadly violence at a school in Fagersta," police said in a statement, adding that one person at the scene was later taken into custody. A police spokesperson told Reuters there was no longer any danger to the public. Several other schools and public buildings in Fagersta had been placed in lockdown after the sword attack took place. Citing unnamed sources, the daily Expressen said police had shot the suspect in the case but Reuters could not immediately confirm the report. The incident comes a year after a school shooting in Orebro, also in central Sweden, when a gunman killed 10 people before turning the weapon on himself, in the worst mass shooting in Swedish history. The Swedish government is in close contact with the police following Friday's attack, Justice Minister Gunnar Strommer said in a statement to Reuters. "All of Sweden stands together with Fagersta at this difficult time," said Labour Party leader Magdalena Andersson, whose centre-left coalition holds a clear lead in opinion polls ahead of next month's parliamentary election.

item.title: Futbolistas surcoreanos reclaman mayores medidas de protección contra el calor
item.description: Los futbolistas profesionales surcoreanos han pedido mayores medidas de protección contra el calor extremo después de que una encuesta realizada por la Asociación Coreana de Futbolistas Profesionales (KPFA) revelara que muchos jugadores sufren deshidratación, mareos y pérdidas temporales de conciencia en las competiciones.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los futbolistas profesionales surcoreanos han pedido mayores medidas de protección contra el calor extremo después de que una encuesta realizada por la Asociación Coreana de Futbolistas Profesionales (KPFA) revelara que muchos jugadores sufren deshidratación, mareos y pérdidas temporales de conciencia en las competiciones. La encuesta reveló que el 86,2% de los encuestados sufrió un esfuerzo físico considerable al jugar bajo el calor, entre los 536 jugadores de la K League y la WK League encuestados durante un verano boreal en el que las temperaturas en el terreno de juego superaron los 40 grados Celsius. Casi dos tercios (64,7%) se quejaron de mareos durante los partidos o los entrenamientos, mientras que el 56,6% sufrió deshidratación grave y el 13% perdió la conciencia temporalmente. "El hecho de que más de 70 jugadores experimentaran mareos, deshidratación e incluso pérdida temporal de conciencia es una señal de alarma evidente", declaró en un comunicado el presidente de la KPFA, Lee Keun-ho, exjugador de la selección nacional. El sindicato instó a la Federación Coreana de Fútbol (KFA), a la K League y a la WK League a que introduzcan protocolos obligatorios contra el calor, alegando que las medidas de seguridad actuales no protegen suficientemente a los jugadores. La KFA declaró a Reuters que la salud y la seguridad de los jugadores sigue siendo su "máxima prioridad absoluta" y que reconoce plenamente las preocupaciones planteadas por el sindicato de jugadores. El organismo rector señaló que está tomando medidas para reducir los riesgos relacionados con el calor, entre ellas ajustar los calendarios de los partidos y hacer cumplir los protocolos de pausas para refrescarse durante los encuentros, al tiempo que señalaba algunas dificultades logísticas. "Aunque nos enfrentamos a ciertas limitaciones prácticas, como la disponibilidad de los estadios y las restricciones de un calendario apretado, la KFA supervisa continuamente las condiciones para hacer todo lo posible por prevenir cualquier incidente relacionado con el calor", declaró la KFA en un comunicado el viernes.

item.title: Panamakanal hat zu wenig Wasser - Deutsche Reeder von Limits betroffen
item.description: Die anstehende Reduzierung des Schiffsverkehrs im Panamakanal aufgrund von Niedrigwasser wirkt sich auch auf Deutschlands Reeder aus. "Verschiedene deutsche Unternehmen nutzen den Kanal regelmäßig mit Container-, Massengut- und Tankschiffen sowie Gas- und Autotransportern", teilte der Verband Deutscher Reeder (VDR) am Freitag mit. Wie viele Schiffe deutscher Reedereien aktuell konkret betroffen seien, lasse sich allerdings nicht beziffern. Schließlich würden die Flotten weltweit, auf wechselnden Routen und in unterschiedlichen Charterverhältnissen eingesetzt. Die Panamakanal-Behörde hatte noch im Mai zugesichert, den Verkehr nicht zu begrenzen. Am Donnerstag sah sie sich zur Kursänderung gezwungen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Die anstehende Reduzierung des Schiffsverkehrs im Panamakanal aufgrund von Niedrigwasser wirkt sich auch auf Deutschlands Reeder aus. "Verschiedene deutsche Unternehmen nutzen den Kanal regelmäßig mit Container-, Massengut- und Tankschiffen sowie Gas- und Autotransportern", teilte der Verband Deutscher Reeder (VDR) am Freitag mit. Wie viele Schiffe deutscher Reedereien aktuell konkret betroffen seien, lasse sich allerdings nicht beziffern. Schließlich würden die Flotten weltweit, auf wechselnden Routen und in unterschiedlichen Charterverhältnissen eingesetzt. Die Panamakanal-Behörde hatte noch im Mai zugesichert, den Verkehr nicht zu begrenzen. Am Donnerstag sah sie sich zur Kursänderung gezwungen. Grund sei die Vorbereitung auf eine ungewöhnlich lange El-Nino-Saison, die voraussichtlich zu niedrigeren Wasserständen führen werde, teilte die Behörde mit. Schon von Mai bis August habe die Niederschlagsmenge 34 Prozent unter dem historischen Durchschnitt gelegen. Ab dem 4. September dürfen deshalb nur noch 34 Schiffe pro Tag die Wasserstraße passieren, ab dem 15. September nur noch 32, so die Behörde. Die Kapazität liegt bei etwa 40 Passagen täglich. Bis Juni 2026 gab es entsprechend des Bedarfs durchschnittlich 35 Durchfahrten pro Tag. Laut VDR passieren unter normalen Bedingungen im Schnitt 36 Schiffe den Kanal. Die angekündigte Reduzierung sei "noch kein dramatischer Einbruch, aber eine spürbare Einschränkung", erklärte der Reederverband in Hamburg. Zum Vergleich verwies der VDR auch auf die schwere Dürre 2023/24, in der zeitweise nur 22 Passagen pro Tag möglich waren. Die Kanalbehörde begrenzt wegen des aktuellen Niedrigwassers auch den Tiefgang von Schiffen. Für den Welthandel ist der Kanal eine der wichtigsten Wasserstraßen. Die aktuellen Einschränkungen dort treffen laut VDR auf eine ohnehin hohe Nachfrage, weil sich wegen der angespannten Lage in der Straße von Hormus Energieverkehre teilweise verlagert haben. Für die Versorgung Europas mit Gütern aus aller Welt sei der Panamakanal zwar nicht so zentral wie der Suezkanal, so der Verband. Für bestimmte Waren und Verbindungen sei er aber von herausragender Bedeutung, insbesondere für Containertransporte zwischen Asien und der US-Ostküste. Deutschlands größte Containerreederei Hapag-Lloyd (HLAG.DE) verbindet auf einer Route durch den Panamakanal unter anderem Shanghai mit New York.

item.title: Somali child hunger crisis deepens as facilities close due to aid cuts, UNICEF says
item.description: Nearly 1.9 million children in Somalia are expected to be malnourished this year, with the country seeing a 32% jump in the number of children admitted to facilities with severe acute malnutrition and complications, UNICEF said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nearly 1.9 million children in Somalia are expected to be malnourished this year, with the country seeing a 32% jump in the number of children admitted to facilities with severe acute malnutrition and complications, UNICEF said on Friday. So far, 205 health and nutrition facilities have closed after [USN:L6N4480DZ TEXT:"unprecedented cuts"] to humanitarian aid, the United Nations children's agency said in comments delivered via video call by its spokesperson James Elder. As many as 618 health facilities could close nationwide, he said. “Fewer facilities mean longer journeys for mums and their babies; longer journeys mean later treatment; later treatment means more severe illness and a greater risk of preventable death," Elder said. “This is the wrong moment to retreat. Somalia is confronting a worsening climate crisis – severe drought in parts of the north, conflict and displacement, and, on the back of the war in Iran, rising costs for fuel and fertiliser." Funding to tackle acute malnutrition in parts of Somalia has dropped by more than 80% this year, Médecins Sans Frontières said earlier in August, with the U.S. halting funds and other Western countries also cutting aid. “This all sits side-by-side a terrifying reality in Somalia: this year nearly 1.9 million children are projected to be affected by malnutrition, including almost half a million with severe acute malnutrition, the deadliest form," Elder said.

item.title: Desmaios de Musiala em campo foram resultado de mudança no tratamento, diz técnico do Bayern
item.description: O técnico do Bayern de Munique, Vincent Kompany, afirmou que uma mudança no tratamento de Jamal Musiala para uma disfunção neurológica foi a razão pela qual o meio-campista desmaiou em duas partidas consecutivas e que não há motivo para alarme.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O técnico do Bayern de Munique, Vincent Kompany, afirmou que uma mudança no tratamento de Jamal Musiala para uma disfunção neurológica foi a razão pela qual o meio-campista desmaiou em duas partidas consecutivas e que não há motivo para alarme. O jogador de 23 anos, que integra a seleção alemã, desmaiou seis minutos após entrar em campo na vitória do Bayern por 4 x 2 em partida amistosa contra o Heidenheim, na terça-feira, e precisou de atendimento médico antes de ser retirado do campo. Ele também desmaiou durante a vitória do Bayern por 3 x 1 sobre o RB Leipzig, no sábado, em amistoso. Musiala disse nesta semana que havia sido diagnosticado com o distúrbio e que os episódios eram “atualmente parte do meu dia a dia”. Em declarações antes da partida do Bayern pela Supercopa da Alemanha contra o Borussia Dortmund, no sábado, Kompany procurou acalmar as preocupações sobre a saúde do jogador. “Conversei com o Jamal, e ele disse: ‘tudo bem, você pode falar’”, afirmou ele em coletiva de imprensa. “Com o tratamento, ele mudou algumas coisas e isso causou alguns efeitos colaterais. É normal que, durante o tratamento, a gente tente algo diferente.” O diretor esportivo do Bayern, Max Eberl, afirmou que o clube apoia totalmente o jogador, que desejava que sua condição fosse divulgada publicamente. Musiala não fará parte da escalação para a partida de sábado, o que lhe dará tempo para se adaptar ao fato de que sua condição agora é de conhecimento público. “Sabíamos disso durante toda a última temporada”, disse Eberl. “Os jogadores também sabiam. Para nós, isso se tornou parte do dia a dia." “Ele mudou algo na medicação, e foi por isso que essas situações ficaram evidentes. Vamos dar a ele todo o nosso apoio, já fizemos isso e continuaremos a fazê-lo. Estamos nisso juntos.” Kompany disse que Musiala, que tem enfrentado dificuldades para recuperar sua melhor forma após uma lesão grave em julho de 2025 que o deixou fora dos gramados por seis meses, deu grandes passos à frente e está pronto para mostrar seu valor. “Estou totalmente tranquilo”, disse Kompany. “Agora espero o contra-ataque de Jamal. Tenho a sensação de que ele agora tem todos os recursos para dar essas respostas."

item.title: Petrobras inicia negociação para exploração offshore em Gana
item.description: A Petrobras apresentou manifestação de interesse em blocos exploratórios localizados em áreas offshore da Bacia de Keta, em Gana, na África, informou a companhia nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Petrobras (PETR3.SA) apresentou manifestação de interesse em blocos exploratórios localizados em áreas offshore da Bacia de Keta, em Gana, na África, informou a companhia nesta sexta-feira. Segundo a estatal, o Ministério de Energia e Transição Verde de Gana aprovou a aplicação da Petrobras, que agora entra na fase de negociação direta dos termos dos contratos de exploração. "A iniciativa está alinhada à estratégia da Petrobras de recomposição das reservas de óleo e gás por meio da exploração de novas fronteiras, tanto no Brasil quanto no exterior, conforme previsto em seu Plano de Negócios", acrescentou a companhia, em comunicado ao mercado.

item.title: Israeli shoots dead Palestinian teen after settlers enter West Bank village, officials say
item.description: An Israeli man guarding a group of Jewish settlers who walked onto Palestinian village land on Friday opened fire towards Palestinians who confronted them, killing a 17-year-old and wounding a 70-year-old man, officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Israeli man guarding a group of Jewish settlers who walked onto Palestinian village land on Friday opened fire towards Palestinians who confronted them, killing a 17-year-old and wounding a 70-year-old man, officials said. The incident in the occupied West Bank village of Sa'ir followed the latest in what the Israeli military describes as "unauthorized hikes" by settlers , who enter the outskirts of villages in what Palestinians view as an act of intimidation. The Palestinian villagers threw rocks toward the settlers, "who were present in the area without advance authorization", the military said in a statement. Some of the settlers were injured, it added. "A security official opened fire in the area, and there are Palestinian casualties as a result of the shooting," the military said. Palestinian officials said a 17-year-old boy died after being shot in the chest. The condition of the 70-year-old was not immediately clear. The village of Sa'ir sits near the city of Hebron in a southern West Bank area under Palestinian Authority civil control and where Israelis are generally prohibited from entering. The West Bank, home to 3 million Palestinians and some 500,000 settlers, has seen a rise in settler violence and seizures of land and [USN:L8N4401RW TEXT:"resources"]. A siege by settlers of homes in the village of [USN:L6N44F0J7 TEXT:"Qusra"] this week drew international condemnation. U.N. bodies and most countries view the settlements as illegal under international law regarding military occupations. Israel disputes this, citing biblical links to the area. Overnight, in Jenin in the north, Israeli troops shot and killed a Palestinian man after raiding his home, Palestinian officials said. The military said soldiers shot him after he tried to stab them. No troops were injured, it added.

item.title: Petrobras atinge topo de produção em unidade no pré-sal de Mero
item.description: O navio-plataforma (FPSO) Alexandre de Gusmão, instalado no pré-sal da Bacia de Santos, alcançou o topo de produção de 180 mil barris de óleo por dia (bpd), informou nesta quinta-feira a Petrobras, operadora do campo de Mero, onde ele está instalado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O navio-plataforma (FPSO) Alexandre de Gusmão, instalado no pré-sal da Bacia de Santos, alcançou o topo de produção de 180 mil barris de óleo por dia (bpd), informou nesta quinta-feira a Petrobras, operadora do campo de Mero, onde ele está instalado. Mero é o terceiro maior campo produtor do Brasil, depois de Búzios e Tupi. Alexandre Gusmão é o quinto FPSO instalado no campo de Mero. "Cada unidade que atinge o patamar máximo de produção previsto em projeto, além de contribuir para o resultado da empresa, confirma a superação de grandes desafios técnicos e o acerto das estratégias que temos adotado", disse a diretora de Engenharia, Tecnologia e Inovação da Petrobras, Renata Baruzzi, em nota. O ativo de Mero teve uma produção média de cerca de 740 mil bpd no segundo trimestre de 2026, ainda sem o topo do Alexandre de Gusmão, destacou a diretora de Exploração e Produção da Petrobras, Sylvia Anjos. As operações do campo unitizado de Mero são conduzidas pelo consórcio operado pela Petrobras, em parceria com a Shell Brasil, TotalEnergies, CNPC, CNOOC e Pré-Sal Petróleo S.A (PPSA), como gestora do contrato de partilha e representante da União.

item.title: LA28 Olympic ticket sales top 6 million; next public sale set for 2027
item.description: Ticket sales for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, which have been dubbed the "biggest sporting event in history," have topped 6 million, organizers said on Friday, with the next public sale planned for 2027.
item.dc:creator: Rory Carroll
item.content:encoded: Ticket sales for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, which have been dubbed the "[USN:L2N3V4014 TEXT:"biggest sporting event in history"]," have topped 6 million, organizers said on Friday, with the next public sale planned for 2027. LA28 said most available tickets from its first two sales rounds have been sold for the Games, which will have a record 353 medal events, up from 329 at the Paris Games. The next release will use a first-come, first-served system and include additional inventory across all sports, subject to availability. There will be no more public ticket draws in 2026. LA28 has not set a date for the 2027 sale. Purchase limits used in the initial rounds will be lifted, allowing fans to buy tickets whether or not they took part in earlier sales. Buyers will need an LA28 ID but will not have to register for a draw. Flag football and squash will make their Olympic debut while baseball and softball, cricket and lacrosse all return after absences at the Games, which are set to begin is less than two years' time. Los Angeles was awarded the Games back in 2017 and has used the unusually long runway to sell tickets and secure sponsorship earlier than in a typical Games. The 2027 sales phase will also include the first Paralympic ticket release and the launch of an official resale program. LA28 said only its own secondary marketplace, AXS, Eventim and designated verified resale platforms will be authorized resale channels. "The demand we've seen across both drops is a powerful signal that the world is energized for LA28," LA28 Chairperson and President Casey Wasserman said in a statement. Los Angeles will host the Olympics for a third time in 2028, after staging the Games in 1932 and 1984. It will also host the Paralympic Games for the first time.

item.title: World Rugby y organismos británicos no logran que se desestimen demandas por conmociones cerebrales
item.description: Las demandas presentadas por más de 500 exjugadores de rugby union y rugby league por lesiones neurológicas podrán seguir adelante, según dictaminó el viernes el Tribunal Superior de Londres, a pesar de que sus antiguos abogados no revelaron pruebas médicas clave a los organismos reguladores.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las demandas presentadas por más de 500 exjugadores de rugby union y rugby league por lesiones neurológicas podrán seguir adelante, según dictaminó el viernes el Tribunal Superior de Londres, a pesar de que sus antiguos abogados no revelaron pruebas médicas clave a los organismos reguladores. World Rugby, la Rugby Football Union (RFU) y la Welsh Rugby Union (WRU), así como la Rugby Football League y la British Amateur Rugby League Association, alegaron que los abogados de los demandantes habían incumplido en repetidas ocasiones su obligación de facilitar la documentación. Solicitaron un fallo que pusiera fin a los casos de más de 500 exjugadores profesionales y aficionados de ambas modalidades. Sin embargo, los abogados que representan a los demandantes alegaron que entregaron la gran mayoría de los documentos requeridos y destacaron la importancia más amplia del litigio para los deportes de contacto en Reino Unido. El juez Jeremy Cook afirmó en un fallo escrito que los casos podrían continuar siempre que se presenten los documentos que faltan, y añadió que "los demandantes a título individual no tienen culpa alguna". El caso se inició en 2022, pero se ha visto lastrado por retrasos en la presentación de pruebas, al igual que una demanda paralela interpuesta por exjugadores de rugby a 13. Casi 800 exjugadores de rugby a 15 —entre ellos Steve Thompson y Phil Vickery, miembros del equipo inglés ganador de la Copa del Mundo de 2003— han demandado a World Rugby, a la RFU y a la WRU. Más de 300 exjugadores de rugby a 13 también han emprendido acciones legales. Los exjugadores afirman que los repetidos golpes que provocaron conmociones cerebrales y subconmociones les han dejado con graves afecciones neurológicas y alegan que los organismos reguladores incumplieron su deber de diligencia al no protegerles de dichos riesgos. Los organismos reguladores, sin embargo, niegan que exista, o haya existido, tal deber de diligencia que se extendiera hasta incluir el riesgo a largo plazo de padecer afecciones neurológicas graves, y World Rugby argumentó en su escrito de contestación que las lesiones son un "riesgo inherente" al rugby.

item.title: Climate focus: Forecasters predict strongest super El Nino
item.description: Hello!
item.dc:creator: Sharon Kimathi
item.content:encoded: Hello! Forecasters around the world have confirmed that the developing El Niño weather pattern is likely to be the strongest in living memory. As a quick refresher, the El Niño phenomenon is caused by unusually warm waters in the Pacific Ocean which naturally occurs every two to seven years and can cause more rainfall in certain areas or drought in others. [USN:L8N44I0B6 TEXT:"Britain's Met Office national weather forecaster"] said 2026 is going to be renowned for the development of the largest El Niño in living memory and what is probably the largest such event since the 19th century. The Met Office said 2027 is very likely to replace 2024 as the warmest year on record. Their latest forecasts showed a more than 3 degrees Celsius rise in equatorial Pacific sea-surface temperatures later this year. A typical El Niño causes a rise of 1 C to 2 C, with 2 C considered a major event. [USN:L6N44F09O TEXT:"China's National Climate Centre"] said that the formation of a super El Nino could be the strongest ever recorded. Since the start of the summer, China has already seen the effects of an El Nino, including torrential rain in various regions. Last week, the strongest typhoon to hit China this year, Typhoon Dolphin, unleashed extreme rain across the country's eastern, central and northern regions, far from the coast where it made landfall following a two-week journey across the Pacific Ocean. Elsewhere, heavy rains linked to the [USN:L6N44G13Z TEXT:"El Niño weather phenomenon caused flooding"] in Peru this week that disrupted access to the ancient Inca citadel of Machu Picchu, closed roads due to landslides and flooded homes in the capital Lima. Climate Buzz Europe's hottest town says climate change is reshaping daily life Residents of Floridia, an Italian town in the Province of Syracuse, Sicily, have been struggling to adapt to the extreme heat temperatures. Five years ago, Floridia broke a record when it hit 48.8 degrees Celsius (119.8 degrees Fahrenheit) in August 2021 which turned the Sicilian town into a symbol of Europe's warming climate. This year, Reuters Climate Monitor data showed Floridia reached 2.8 C above the average in July from the 1961-1990 historic norm. [USN:L8N44G0YD TEXT:"Click here"] to read about residents' concerns around heat affecting health and local traditions. Japanese men turn to hair removal in scorching summer In keeping with the theme of extreme heat changing daily life,[USN:L6N44H05K TEXT:" click here"] for an insightful read on how Japanese men are turning to hair removal to survive the sweltering heat leading to a surge in business for grooming clinics. Singapore's plan to clear forest for housing faces a backlash Singapore said in July it was looking to clear two-thirds of the 23-hectare (57-acre) Maju Forest to build more public housing. But the announcement triggered an outcry from residents, leading to more than 49,000 people signing two petitions that urged the government to build on brownfield land, such as golf courses and former commercial and institutional sites, and redevelop older public housing estates at higher densities. [USN:L6N4400GS TEXT:"Click here"] to read the government’s response and more. Serbia turns to Russia to help fight wildfires A [USN:L1N44H0A9 TEXT:"Russian Emergencies Ministry"] IL-76P firefighting plane landed in Serbia’s southern city of Nis this week to tackle a wildfire in the Deliblatska Pescara natural protected reserve that has raged for weeks. Serbia also has access to emergency EU help under the bloc's Civil Protection Mechanism, even though the country is not a member of the European Union. The plane's arrival is another sign of Serbia's balancing act between Russia, with which it has historical ties, and the EU, which it hopes to join. West Africa cocoa sector struggles to meet EU anti-deforestation rules, raising supply concerns Industry experts estimate that when the EU Deforestation Regulation comes into effect at the end of December, farmers across West Africa, including top grower Ivory Coast and Nigeria, would struggle to comply with the law which could squeeze the region's exports to the EU and lead to higher costs for its chocolate makers and its buyers. [USN:L8N447210 TEXT:"Click here"] for the full story. What to Watch Amid a coastal breeze and summer sunshine, a corporate volunteer team joined more than 16,000 New Yorkers who have worked with the Billion Oyster Project, a nonprofit dedicated to restoring oyster reefs in New York Harbor. Click here to watch the full video. Climate Commentary The Science Based Targets initiative’s (SBTi) flagship Net Zero Standard has undergone its first major update, prompting a mixed response from the climate community. Click here to find out more in a piece by Ethical Corp Magazine contributor Oliver Balch . Hungary’s record solar output is helping to shield its power system from the worst effects of the forced cutbacks after the country's only nuclear power plant had to drastically lower output following a drop in water levels on the Danube River. [USN:L1N44H0UG TEXT:"Click here"] to read the full piece by Reuters global energy transition columnist Gavin Maguire . Climate Lens Human-caused climate change has added about 2 C of warming to the Mediterranean and around 1.4 C to Western European seas, according to an analysis by scientists at the World Weather Attribution (WWA) group, which uses peer-reviewed methods to assess global warming's role in extreme weather events. Last month, the average temperature in the Mediterranean was 27 degrees Celsius (81 degrees Fahrenheit), the highest for any July on record, while an offshore buoy near Mallorca recorded 33 C in early August. [USN:L6N44F11Q TEXT:"Click here"] for the full analysis by Reuters Europe climate and energy correspondent Kate Abnett . Number of the Week 72,000 That’s the number of people that [USN:L6N44H0HG TEXT:"Sri Lanka's government"] has arranged to receive water across seven districts as the country tackles a drought linked to this year's severe El Niño, a senior official said.

item.title: Angels' Zach Neto in a groove entering opener vs. Rangers
item.description: Los Angeles' Zach Neto will try to follow up a career night when the Angels face the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Arlington, Texas.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles' Zach Neto will try to follow up a career night when the Angels face the Texas Rangers on Friday night in Arlington, Texas. Neto set career highs with five hits and seven RBIs in the visiting Angels' 18-3 drubbing of the Houston Astros on Thursday. Los Angeles took two of three games from the Astros to capture its first road series since May 26-28 at Detroit. Texas won the decisive contest of its series from the Washington Nationals on Thursday, as Jacob deGrom allowed one hit over six scoreless innings for the Rangers and crossed the 2,000-strikeout plateau. The Rangers will look for revenge after dropping three of four games against the Angels from Aug. 10-13. Los Angeles' Reid Detmers (4-8, 3.78 ERA) will oppose Texas' MacKenzie Gore (7-9, 4.45) on Friday in a battle of left-handers. Detmers is 1-2 with a 1.83 ERA and 44 strikeouts and eight walks over his last six outings (34 1/3 innings). He turned in his best start of the season in his most recent game, striking out 11 batters and scattering two hits over eight scoreless innings in a 1-0 win over the Kansas City Royals on Saturday. "That's what an ace does," Angels manager Kurt Suzuki said. "And he pitched like that tonight and was just in control the whole time. Really never any nervous at-bats. You could see he was locked in. He was hitting his spots, and they weren't picking up his slider." Detmers is 3-3 with a 4.22 ERA in 19 career appearances (13 starts) vs. the Rangers. He will make his fourth start of the season against them. All three so far have been no-decisions. Detmers received one against Texas on Aug. 10 despite allowing one run on three hits over six innings. He experienced the same fate vs. the Rangers on July 9 when he gave up five runs on seven hits (three of them homers) in four innings. And he also got a no-decision against them on May 24, allowing one run over eight innings while striking out a career-high 14 batters. Gore has not gotten past the sixth inning in his past three starts, but Texas has won each time. Last Saturday, he allowed three runs on eight hits in 5 2/3 innings to beat the Athletics 5-3. Gore is 0-2 with a 4.13 ERA in five career appearances (all starts) against the Angels. Friday's game will mark his fourth start this season vs. the club; he has an 0-1 record thus far. On Aug. 10, he gave up a run over 5 1/3 innings and struck out nine in a no-decision. He was hit hard and took the loss on July 8, allowing seven runs on nine hits over five innings. In the May 24 contest, he took a no-decision after giving up a run over six innings. Against the Astros on Thursday, Denzer Guzman homered and Vaughn Grissom had three hits. Neto, with a three-run homer, double and three singles, became the first Angel to record seven RBIs since Shohei Ohtani in 2022. "Felt good. Seeing the ball well," Neto said. "My teammates put me in a really good spot to hit." Despite the Angels' offensive outburst, the news was not all good. Left fielder Wade Meckler exited in the fifth inning after getting hit on the head by a pitch, and first baseman Nolan Schanuel left in the sixth with right side soreness. Meckler was being evaluated for a concussion after the game. In Arlington, Corey Seager produced his fourth straight two-hit game with a solo homer and a double. Ezequiel Duran reached four times with two hits and two walks, and the bullpen provided three scoreless innings. "The defense was unbelievable tonight," Texas manager Skip Schumaker said. "The bullpen locked it down, but clean defense is why we locked it down also." --Field Level Media

item.title: Statistics Canada reports retail sales up 0.6 per cent in June at $74.3B
item.description: Statistics Canada says retail sales rose 0.6 per cent to $74.3 billion in June, boosted by sales at general merchandise retailers.
item.dc:creator: The Canadian Press
item.content:encoded: OTTAWA — Statistics Canada says retail sales rose 0.6 per cent to $74.3 billion in June, boosted by sales at general merchandise retailers. However, the agency says its preliminary estimate for July pointed to a drop of 0.8 per cent for that month, though it cautioned the figure would be revised. For June, Statistics Canada says sales were up in seven of nine subsectors, including a 2.7 per cent increase at general merchandise stores. Sales at clothing, clothing accessories, shoes, jewelry, luggage and leather goods retailers added 3.1 per cent. Core retail sales, which exclude gasoline stations and fuel vendors and motor vehicle and parts dealers, gained 1.2 per cent in June. In volume terms, retail sales increased 1.5 per cent in June. This report by The Canadian Press was first published Aug. 21, 2026. The Canadian Press

item.title: Un sospechoso ucraniano de la explosión del Nord Stream es detenido en Croacia
item.description: Un ciudadano ucraniano sospechoso de estar implicado en las explosiones de los gasoductos Nord Stream en 2022 quedó en prisión preventiva en Croacia a la espera de una decisión sobre su extradición a Alemania, dijeron el viernes funcionarios judiciales.
item.dc:creator: Daria Sito-sucic
item.content:encoded: Un ciudadano ucraniano sospechoso de estar implicado en las explosiones de los gasoductos Nord Stream en 2022 quedó en prisión preventiva en Croacia a la espera de una decisión sobre su extradición a Alemania, dijeron el viernes funcionarios judiciales. El sospechoso —descrito como buzo por la Fiscalía alemana, que sólo lo ha identificado como Vladimir Z.— fue detenido en la madrugada del miércoles en un hotel de la ciudad costera croata de Pula, en virtud de una orden de detención europea. La fiscalía alemana dijo que Vladimir Z. formaba parte del grupo responsable de las explosiones, ocurridas después de que Moscú lanzara su invasión a gran escala de Ucrania ese mismo año. Las explosiones —calificadas de sabotaje tanto por Rusia como por países occidentales— dañaron el gasoducto Nord Stream 1, una ruta crucial para las exportaciones de gas ruso a Europa, así como el ramal Nord Stream 2, que aún no había entrado en servicio. Otro sospechoso en el caso, el exoficial del ejército ucraniano Serhii K., fue acusado formalmente por la fiscalía en julio de organizar las explosiones mientras actuaba en nombre de entidades estatales ucranianas. Ese hombre —detenido en Italia en agosto de 2025 y trasladado a Alemania en noviembre— ha negado cualquier implicación en las explosiones ocurridas cerca de la isla danesa de Bornholm. Funcionarios judiciales de Pula dijeron que el sospechoso detenido allí esta semana quedó en prisión preventiva el jueves a petición de la Fiscalía del condado, que lo interrogó. No ofrecieron detalles sobre si se había declarado culpable o inocente. Los tribunales alemanes han considerado que el caso está dentro de su jurisdicción porque los gasoductos dañados terminan en el estado alemán de Mecklemburgo-Pomerania Occidental y su pérdida afectó la seguridad energética e interior de Alemania. El ministro del Interior alemán, Alexander Dobrindt, dijo que su ministerio ha estado en contacto con las autoridades croatas para facilitar la extradición del sospechoso, aunque señaló que los procedimientos pueden llevar tiempo. "Tenemos un gran interés en esclarecer los hechos en este contexto y (...) garantizar que los responsables sean llevados a Alemania, donde se tomarán las medidas correspondientes contra ellos", añadió Dobrindt.

item.title: El Niño, e não terremoto, afetará safra de café da Colômbia, diz líder do setor
item.description: A safra de café da Colômbia escapou do impacto de um forte terremoto que atingiu regiões agrícolas em toda a parte ocidental do país, afirmou o presidente da Federação Nacional dos Cafeicultores à Reuters em entrevista na quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
item.content:encoded: A safra de café da Colômbia escapou do impacto de um forte terremoto que atingiu regiões agrícolas em toda a parte ocidental do país, afirmou o presidente da Federação Nacional dos Cafeicultores à Reuters em entrevista na quinta-feira. Apesar dos danos generalizados causados pelo terremoto de magnitude 7,4, os cafeicultores consideram as condições climáticas severas de um ano de El Niño como a maior ameaça, disse o chefe da federação, German Bahamon. “A produção em si não foi afetada pelo terremoto. É muito provável que a produção seja afetada pelo fenômeno El Niño”, disse Bahamon em entrevista. O El Niño é um aquecimento periódico das temperaturas da superfície do mar no Pacífico oriental, causado pelo enfraquecimento dos ventos alísios. [USN:L8N44F09S TEXT:"Analistas"] globais [USN:L8N44F09S TEXT:"afirmam que"] o padrão climático do El Niño está se intensificando e pode se transformar em um evento muito forte no final deste ano e no início de 2027, elevando as temperaturas, alterando os padrões de chuva e representando riscos para as safras em todo o mundo. A federação espera que a produção deste ano caia 8%, para 12,5 milhões de sacas de 60 quilos, ante 13,7 milhões de sacas em 2025, devido às chuvas intensas no começo do ano e ao início do El Niño. O [USN:L6N4470MM TEXT:"terremoto ocorrido na Colômbia"] em 10 de agosto matou 319 pessoas e causou danos à infraestrutura em províncias responsáveis por cerca de um terço da safra do país. Levantamentos iniciais identificaram 10.500 famílias produtoras de café na zona do desastre, sendo que 8.000 relataram destruição parcial ou total de suas casas e instalações de processamento. A federação planeja liderar um programa de reconstrução em conjunto com a ajuda governamental, incluindo um programa de compra de cerejas de café colhidas. As exportações de Buenaventura, o principal porto cafeeiro da Colômbia, responsável por 60% dos embarques, voltaram ao normal após inspeções de segurança temporárias e bloqueios nas estradas. “Não houve problemas com as exportações... Elas estão ocorrendo perfeitamente”, disse Bahamon. A Colômbia é o terceiro maior produtor mundial de café e o principal fornecedor de arábica lavado. Aproximadamente 540 mil famílias dependem do setor, que abrange 840 mil hectares. Além das preocupações climáticas, Bahamon alertou que a valorização do peso colombiano -- em seu nível mais alto desde outubro de 2018 -- está corroendo as margens de lucro dos produtores. Ele estimou que os produtores estão perdendo 700 mil pesos (US$ 229) por carga de 125 kg devido à valorização em relação ao dólar. (Reportagem de Luis Jaime Acosta)

item.title: Minério de ferro fica estável enquanto traders avaliam estoques em portos e rentabilidade de usinas
item.description: Os contratos futuros de minério de ferro tiveram pouca variação nesta sexta-feira, com a redução dos estoques nos principais portos chineses dando apoio aos preços e equilibrando a pressão de uma queda na lucratividade das usinas siderúrgicas.
item.dc:creator: Emily Yong
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros de minério de ferro tiveram pouca variação nesta sexta-feira, com a redução dos estoques nos principais portos chineses dando apoio aos preços e equilibrando a pressão de uma queda na lucratividade das usinas siderúrgicas. O contrato de minério de ferro para janeiro mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) da China subiu 0,21%, a 707,5 iuanes (US$105,27) por tonelada. O contrato registrou queda de 0,63% nesta semana. A referência de minério de ferro para setembro na Bolsa de Cingapura avançava 0,25%, para US$96,85 por tonelada. No acumulado da semana, marcava uma queda de 0,11%. Os estoques de minério de ferro nos principais portos chineses caíram 0,27% em relação à semana anterior, para 156,38 milhões de toneladas, segundo dados da consultoria Steelhome. Os estoques nos principais portos mostraram uma ligeira tendência de redução, e a demanda por minério de ferro permanece estável no curto prazo, afirmaram analistas da Shanghai Metals Market em nota. A lucratividade das siderúrgicas caiu 1,3 ponto percentual em relação ao mês anterior, para 32,47%, segundo dados da consultoria Mysteel. As siderúrgicas têm reduzido a produção em vez de retomá-la, pressionadas por um aumento nos preços do carvão de coque que reduziu as margens, afirmaram analistas da GF Futures em nota. (Reportagem de Emily Ou Yong)

item.title: India gets $511.5 million in FDI under new policy for neighbouring countries
item.description: India has received 29 foreign direct investment proposals worth 48.95 billion rupees ($511.5 million) under a new automatic route that allows investors from land-bordering countries, including China, to hold non-controlling stakes of up to 10%, the government said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India has received 29 foreign direct investment proposals worth 48.95 billion rupees ($511.5 million) under a new automatic route that allows investors from land-bordering countries, including China, to hold non-controlling stakes of up to 10%, the government said on Friday. The investments span information technology, artificial intelligence, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, data centres and transport services, India's commerce and industry ministry said. The disclosures offer an early indication of investor use of rules introduced in May that eased approval requirements for companies with limited, non-controlling ownership from countries sharing a land border with India. Under the revised framework, investors with non-controlling ownership of up to 10% from land-bordering countries, mainly China, may invest through the automatic route, subject to applicable sectoral caps and other conditions. Previously, foreign investors with any beneficial ownership linked to countries sharing a land border with India generally needed prior government approval under rules introduced in 2020, including where such ownership was small. "The 29 investments have been reported by investors/entities based in jurisdictions including Mauritius, the United States, the Republic of Korea, Japan, Singapore, Luxembourg and the Cayman Islands," the ministry said in a statement. ($1 = 95.6950 Indian rupees)

item.title: Federación Danesa de Fútbol pide alternativa a presidencia de la FIFA tras caída de apoyo a Infantino
item.description: La Federación Danesa de Fútbol (DBU) se ha comprometido a encontrar una alternativa creíble al presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, en las elecciones del próximo año, y declaró el viernes que ha perdido la confianza en el máximo responsable del organismo rector del fútbol mundial.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Federación Danesa de Fútbol (DBU) se ha comprometido a encontrar una alternativa creíble al presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, en las elecciones del próximo año, y declaró el viernes que ha perdido la confianza en el máximo responsable del organismo rector del fútbol mundial. La DBU afirmó que la propuesta frustrada de Infantino de vender participaciones comerciales en los torneos de la FIFA, incluida la Copa del Mundo, había provocado "una crisis fundamental de confianza en el liderazgo de la FIFA" que no podía subsanarse con retiradas ni disculpas. La DBU afirmó que no apoyó a Infantino en las elecciones de 2023 y que tampoco lo hará en las próximas, que se celebrarán con ocasión del 77º Congreso de la FIFA en Rabat (Marruecos), el 18 de marzo. "Nos complace que varias federaciones estén retirando ahora su apoyo", declaró la DBU en un comunicado tras una reunión de su junta directiva. "La DBU, junto con la UEFA y nuestros colegas internacionales, trabajará para garantizar que las federaciones miembro dispongan, en las elecciones presidenciales de 2027, de una opción real y una alternativa creíble capaz de unir a la FIFA más allá de las confederaciones y de reconstruir la confianza que se ha perdido", señaló. La FIFA se disculpó a principios de mes ante sus federaciones miembro por los errores cometidos en relación con la propuesta abandonada, pero su dirección reafirmó su apoyo a Infantino tras una reunión de crisis celebrada en Marruecos. "La confianza en Gianni Infantino se ha esfumado, y ni la retirada de la propuesta ni la posterior disculpa por la gestión del proceso cambian esa valoración", añadió la DBU. "Los acontecimientos de la última semana no hacen más que subrayar aún más el deseo de la junta directiva de contar con un nuevo presidente de la FIFA". El plazo para presentar candidaturas a las elecciones presidenciales finaliza el 18 de noviembre, pero hasta el momento nadie más ha anunciado oficialmente su candidatura. Infantino aspira a un cuarto mandato hasta 2031, pero varias federaciones nacionales y dirigentes clave han retirado su apoyo al suizo. Las potencias regionales de este deporte también han debatido la posibilidad de presentar un voto de censura en su contra. Infantino se encuentra bajo presión para dimitir por parte de tres confederaciones: la UEFA europea, la AFC asiática y la Concacaf, que representa a América del Norte, América Central y el Caribe. Sin embargo, sigue contando con el respaldo de la confederación africana (CAF) y de varios países asiáticos que han prometido apoyar su reelección, mientras que potencias como Argentina y México también le han dado su apoyo.

item.title: La Chine part à la recherche de glace lunaire dans l’un des endroits les plus froids du système solaire
item.description: La Chine s'apprête à lancer Chang'e-7, sa mission lunaire la plus complexe sur le plan technologique à ce jour, afin de rechercher des réserves d'eau gelée dans des cratères situés dans des zones d'ombre permanente près du pôle sud de la Lune.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Chine s'apprête à lancer Chang'e-7, sa mission lunaire la plus complexe sur le plan technologique à ce jour, afin de rechercher des réserves d'eau gelée dans des cratères situés dans des zones d'ombre permanente près du pôle sud de la Lune. Cette mission non habitée, nommée d'après une déesse mythique chinoise de la Lune, prévoit le déploiement d'un atterrisseur robotisé, d'un rover et d'une sonde "sauteuse" dans l'un des endroits les plus froids du système solaire. Elle constituera une étape majeure vers l'objectif à long terme de Pékin d'établir une présence humaine permanente sur la Lune, avec des projets en cours pour effectuer un alunissage habité avant 2030 et mettre en place une station de recherche conjointe avec la Russie d'ici 2035. OÙ IRA CHANG'E-7? La semaine prochaine, le vaisseau spatial Chang'e-7 décollera du site de lancement spatial de Wenchang, dans la province insulaire de Hainan, dans le sud de la Chine, à bord d'une fusée Longue Marche 5, avec à son bord une charge utile comprenant une série d'instruments scientifiques tels que des analyseurs d'eau, des caméras et des radars. Une fois en orbite autour de la Lune, le vaisseau spatial examinera d'abord les sites d'atterrissage potentiels au pôle Sud avant de tenter de se poser. L'un des sites envisagés se trouve près du bord du cratère Shackleton, une dépression plongée dans l'ombre permanente. Le bord dentelé du cratère est toutefois presque continuellement éclairé par la lumière du soleil. La Chine n'a pas rendu public de calendrier pour la mission Chang'e-7, mais les observateurs du secteur spatial estiment qu'une tentative d’atterrissage pourrait avoir lieu vers novembre. Après l'atterrissage, le rover et la sonde sautillante commenceront à explorer la surface. La durée de la mission reste inconnue. POURQUOI LE PÔLE SUD? Les cratères situés près du pôle Sud de la Lune n'ont pas vu la lumière du soleil depuis des milliards d'années. Les scientifiques pensent donc qu'ils pourraient servir de congélateurs naturels, capables de préserver de l’eau ancienne ainsi que des composés organiques volatils. Les températures peuvent descendre jusqu'à moins 203 degrés Celsius dans certaines de ces zones d'ombre, selon la Nasa. La découverte d'eau accessible est essentielle pour les futures bases lunaires, car elle pourrait fournir de l’eau potable, de l'oxygène aux astronautes et même servir de propergol pour les fusées, réduisant ainsi le besoin de missions de ravitaillement coûteuses depuis la Terre. Contrairement à la plupart des régions de la Lune, où la nuit lunaire peut durer jusqu’à 14 jours terrestres, les sommets élevés et les bords de cratères proches du pôle Sud bénéficient d'un ensoleillement quasi permanent. Ils constitueraient donc un emplacement idéal pour un avant-poste lunaire, avec un environnement thermique relativement stable et une source continue d’énergie solaire. Les États-Unis, l’Inde et la Russie ont eux aussi fixé leur attention sur le pôle Sud lunaire. Seule l’Inde s’est posée à proximité, avec [USN:L6N3A50CM TEXT:"Chandrayaan-3"] en 2023. Au cours des prochaines années, le rover VIPER de la Nasa, le système de forage PROSPECT de l'Agence spatiale européenne (ESA) et le rover LUPEX développé par le Japon et l’Inde devraient atteindre le pôle Sud lunaire, alors que la course à la découverte de sources d’eau s’intensifie. UN ROBOT SAUTEUR? DANS L’OBSCURITÉ? L'un des défis auxquels sont confrontés les rovers traditionnels à roues est la forte pente des bords de cratères. Pour descendre jusqu’au fond plongé dans l’obscurité totale d'un cratère, Chang’e-7 déploiera une nouvelle sonde sauteuse. Équipée d’un analyseur de molécules d’eau, la sonde utilisera de petits propulseurs pour pénétrer dans les cratères plongés dans l’ombre. Elle se posera ensuite sur six pattes articulées avant de bondir à nouveau vers les zones ensoleillées afin de recharger ses batteries. Les caractéristiques techniques relatives à la masse de la sonde, aux performances de sa propulsion ou à son autonomie de vol restent inconnues. Selon l'agence de presse officielle chinoise Xinhua, le véhicule devrait effectuer au moins trois sauts au cours de la mission. QUI EST LE CONCURRENT DE LA CHINE DANS LA COURSE LUNAIRE ? Les données collectées par Chang’e-7 et son successeur Chang’e-8, prévu vers 2029, seront cruciales pour le projet chinois d’un alunissage habité d’ici 2030. Ces deux missions doivent jeter les bases d’une station de recherche habitée en permanence. L’ambition de la Chine d’envoyer des hommes sur la Lune et de construire un avant-poste près du pôle Sud coïncide avec le programme Artemis de la Nasa, qui vise à renvoyer des hommes sur la Lune d’ici 2028 et, à terme, à y établir une présence humaine durable. En avril, [USN:L6N40U000 TEXT:"la mission Artemis II"] a achevé un survol lunaire habité de 10 jours. Les quatre astronautes se sont aventurés plus loin dans l’espace que n’importe quel être humain auparavant, atteignant une distance record de 252.756 miles de la Terre avant de rentrer chez eux sains et saufs.

item.title: Dobrindt bestätigt Waffenfund nahe Berlin - Verdacht auf Anschlagspläne
item.description: Bundesinnenminister Alexander Dobrindt hat den Fund eines geheimen Waffenlagers am Stadtrand von Berlin im vergangenen Oktober bestätigt. Nach Berichten der "Süddeutschen Zeitung", des NDR und des WDR waren die Handfeuerwaffen mutmaßlich für Morde im Auftrag russischer Geheimdienste bestimmt. Dobrindt erklärte am Freitag, die Bundesanwaltschaft ermittle gegen einen Verdächtigen wegen geheimdienstlicher Agententätigkeit und der Vorbereitung einer schweren staatsgefährdenden Gewalttat. Der Mann befinde sich in Rumänien in Haft. Zur Staatsangehörigkeit des Verdächtigen machte der Minister auf Nachfrage keine Angaben. Eine Beteiligung fremder Mächte wollte Dobrindt nicht ausschließen.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesinnenminister Alexander Dobrindt hat den Fund eines geheimen Waffenlagers am Stadtrand von Berlin im vergangenen Oktober bestätigt. Nach Berichten der "Süddeutschen Zeitung", des NDR und des WDR waren die Handfeuerwaffen mutmaßlich für Morde im Auftrag russischer Geheimdienste bestimmt. Dobrindt erklärte am Freitag, die Bundesanwaltschaft ermittle gegen einen Verdächtigen wegen geheimdienstlicher Agententätigkeit und der Vorbereitung einer schweren staatsgefährdenden Gewalttat. Der Mann befinde sich in Rumänien in Haft. Zur Staatsangehörigkeit des Verdächtigen machte der Minister auf Nachfrage keine Angaben. Eine Beteiligung fremder Mächte wollte Dobrindt nicht ausschließen. Dem Verfassungsschutz und dem Landeskriminalamt Berlin war es im Oktober gelungen, das Versteck mit zwei Handfeuerwaffen und Munition ausfindig zu machen. Dort wurden den Angaben zufolge zwei Handfeuerwaffen und Munition sichergestellt. Die Waffen seien umgehend unbrauchbar gemacht worden, um jede Gefahr auszuschließen, sagte Dobrindt. Eine anschließende Überwachung des Depots habe jedoch keine Erkenntnisse über mögliche Abnehmer geliefert. Medienberichten zufolge ist der Verfassungsschutz davon überzeugt, dass die Hintermänner auf Weisung russischer Dienste handelten. Als potenzielle Ziele für Anschläge galten demnach Führungskräfte der Rüstungsindustrie, im Exil lebende Oppositionelle sowie Unterstützer der Ukraine. Eine Reaktion der russischen Botschaft lag zunächst nicht vor. Dobrindt betonte, der Fall füge sich in ein hybrides Bedrohungsszenario ein. Die Sicherheitsbehörden hätten die Gefährdungslage für Deutschland vor einigen Monaten von einer abstrakten auf eine hohe heraufgestuft. Bei dem Einsatz hätten die deutschen Behörden eng mit Partnerdiensten aus dem Ausland zusammengearbeitet. Es handele sich zudem nicht um einen Einzelfall. Die Sicherheitsbehörden verzeichneten eine Vielzahl von Aktivitäten sogenannter "untergeordneter Agenten". So sei unter anderem im April ein kasachischer Staatsbürger in Berlin wegen mutmaßlicher Spionage festgenommen worden, im August sei eine weitere Festnahme wegen des Verdachts auf Sabotageaktivitäten gefolgt.

item.title: Germany seeks extradition from Romania after gun stash found near Berlin
item.description: Germany is in touch with Romania over the possible extradition of a man detained there in connection with a gun stash found in a forest near Berlin last year, said Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Germany is in touch with Romania over the possible extradition of a man detained there in connection with [USN:L6N44I0J5 TEXT:"a gun stash"] found in a forest near Berlin last year, said Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt on Friday. "This case demonstrates that we are operating under a high threat level," said Dobrindt at a press conference. He described the suspect as a "low-level agent" without knowledge of the line of command steering him, adding that several similarly uninformed operatives had been detained so far this year, including one Kazakh national. While earlier media reports by Sueddeutsche Zeitung and other outlets quoted sources as saying that German intelligence believes the weapons were meant to be used for assassinations on behalf of Russian intelligence, the minister only said he could not rule out the involvement of foreign powers. Dobrindt said the suspect, whose nationality he would not disclose, was also held in connection with planned parcel bomb attacks in Romania. This would play a role in talks with Romanian authorities over a potential extradition. "We will then determine, in the course of the investigation, what measures can be taken against this person," he added. Romania's justice ministry did not immediately reply to a request for comment. Dobrindt said the stash, which also included ammunition, was placed under surveillance for months after its discovery but nobody was seen approaching it.

item.title: Ukrainian Nord Stream blast suspect detained in Croatia
item.description: A Ukrainian man suspected of being involved in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline blasts has been placed into pre-trial detention in Croatia pending a decision on his extradition to Germany, court officials said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Daria Sito-sucic
item.content:encoded: A Ukrainian man suspected of being involved in the 2022 [USN:L8N3UD0YM TEXT:"Nord Stream pipeline blasts"] has been placed into pre-trial detention in Croatia pending a decision on his extradition to Germany, court officials said on Friday. The suspect - described as a scuba diver by German prosecutors who have identified him only as Vladimir Z. - [USN:L6N44G0KY TEXT:"was arrested"] in the early hours on Wednesday in a hotel in the Croatian coastal city of Pula on a European arrest warrant. German prosecutors have said Vladimir Z. was part of a group behind the blasts which followed Moscow's full-scale invasion of Ukraine earlier that year. The explosions - described by Russia and Western countries as sabotage - damaged the Nord Stream 1 pipeline, a vital route for Russian gas exports to Europe, as well as the Nord Stream 2 branch, which had yet to enter service. Another suspect in the case, former Ukrainian army officer Serhii K., [USN:L8N4340JH TEXT:"was charged by prosecutors"] in July with orchestrating the blasts while acting on behalf of Ukrainian state entities. That man - who was arrested in Italy in August 2025 and transferred to Germany in November - has denied any involvement in the blasts near the Danish island of Bornholm. Court officials in Pula said the suspect arrested there this week was put in detention on Thursday following a request from the county state attorney, who has questioned him. They gave no details on whether he had entered a plea. German courts have treated the case as falling within their jurisdiction because the damaged pipelines end in the German state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, and their loss affected Germany's energy security and internal safety. German Interior Minister Alexander Dobrindt said his ministry has been in contact with the Croatian authorities to facilitate the suspect's extradition but that the procedures can take time. "We have a strong interest in clarifying the facts in this context and ... ensuring that the perpetrators are brought to Germany, where they will be dealt with appropriately,” Dobrindt added.

item.title: Pogacar apunta al título de la Vuelta a España para intentar completar el triplete
item.description: Tadej Pogacar quiere cumplir un "gran sueño" sumando el título de la Vuelta a España a su palmarés cuando regrese a la carrera por primera vez desde 2019.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tadej Pogacar quiere cumplir un "gran sueño" sumando el título de la Vuelta a España a su palmarés cuando regrese a la carrera por primera vez desde 2019. La Vuelta es la única de las Grandes Vueltas que aún no ha ganado el ciclista de 27 años, quien el mes pasado conquistó su quinto título del Tour de Francia —igualando el récord— y se impuso en el Giro de Italia en 2024. Una victoria convertiría a Pogacar en el noveno ciclista en ganar las tres Grandes Vueltas, una hazaña que su rival Jonas Vingegaard consiguió este año al imponerse en el Giro de Italia. "Ha pasado muy poco tiempo desde el Tour de Francia hasta llegar aquí, pero tuve tiempo suficiente para recuperarme y, además, esta carrera comienza cerca de mi casa", dijo Pogacar a periodistas el jueves. "Estoy deseando que empiece. Es uno de los objetivos que me faltan en mi carrera, así que daré lo mejor de mí para intentar ganar". "Ganar las tres Grandes Vueltas ha sido para mí un gran objetivo y un sueño desde hace varios años". Sin embargo, el esloveno afirmó que no podía permitirse terminar La Vuelta completamente exhausto, ya que después deberá afrontar el Mundial, el Campeonato Europeo y el Giro de Lombardía. "Tendré que evaluar mi estado de forma en las primeras etapas, teniendo siempre presentes las tres grandes carreras posteriores", añadió el corredor del UAE Team Emirates-XRG, que terminó tercero en su única participación anterior en la Vuelta, cuando debutó en una Gran Vuelta. "No debería terminar esta carrera completamente destrozado. Tengo que correr con inteligencia y después ver, durante las primeras etapas, cómo la afrontamos". La Vuelta se disputará del 22 de agosto al 13 de septiembre y comenzará en Mónaco.

item.title: Instituto meteorológico britânico prevê El Niño mais forte de que se tem memória
item.description: O Met Office, órgão nacional de previsão do tempo do Reino Unido, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o fenômeno climático El Niño, que está se formando, provavelmente será o mais intenso de que se tem memória.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O Met Office, órgão nacional de previsão do tempo do Reino Unido, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o fenômeno climático El Niño, que está se formando, provavelmente será o mais intenso de que se tem memória. O El Niño é um aquecimento periódico das temperaturas da superfície do mar no Pacífico oriental, causado pelo enfraquecimento dos ventos alísios. Ele ocorre naturalmente a cada dois a sete anos e tende a durar entre nove e 12 meses. Seu efeito sobre o clima global pode ameaçar as safras em todo o mundo. O ano de 2026 ficará marcado pelo desenvolvimento do maior El Niño da história recente e pelo que provavelmente será o maior evento desse tipo desde o século 19, afirmou o Met Office. Segundo o Met Office, é muito provável que 2027 substitua 2024 como o ano mais quente já registrado. Suas previsões mais recentes indicaram um aumento de mais de 3 graus Celsius nas temperaturas da superfície do mar no Pacífico equatorial ainda este ano. Um El Niño típico causa um aumento de 1°C a 2°C, sendo que 2 °C é considerado um evento de grande magnitude. “Isso significa que, se a previsão estiver correta — e outros sistemas de previsão indicarem valores extremos semelhantes —, então 2026 superará em muito nossa experiência recente com o El Niño e suas influências climáticas em todo o mundo”, disse Adam Scaife, chefe de previsões de longo prazo.

item.title: Desmayos de Musiala en el campo se debieron a cambio de tratamiento: entrenador del Bayern, Kompany
item.description: El entrenador del Bayern de Múnich, Vincent Kompany, afirmó que un cambio en el tratamiento de Jamal Musiala por una disfunción neurológica fue la causa de que el centrocampista se desmayara en dos partidos consecutivos y que no hay motivo para alarmarse.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El entrenador del Bayern de Múnich, Vincent Kompany, afirmó que un cambio en el tratamiento de Jamal Musiala por una disfunción neurológica fue la causa de que el centrocampista se desmayara en dos partidos consecutivos y que no hay motivo para alarmarse. El internacional alemán, de 23 años, se desplomó seis minutos después de salir del banquillo en la victoria por 4-2 del Bayern en el partido amistoso disputado el martes en Heidenheim, y tuvo que recibir asistencia médica antes de ser ayudado a abandonar el terreno de juego. También se desmayó durante la victoria por 3-1 del equipo muniqués en el partido amistoso contra el RB Leipzig el sábado. Musiala declaró esta semana que le habían diagnosticado este trastorno y que los episodios formaban "parte de mi día a día en estos momentos". En declaraciones previas al partido de la Supercopa de Alemania que el Bayern disputará el sábado contra el Borussia Dortmund, Kompany se apresuró a calmar las preocupaciones sobre la salud del jugador. "Hablé con Jamal y me dijo: 'No hay problema, puedes decirlo'", declaró en una rueda de prensa. "Con su tratamiento ha cambiado algunas cosas y eso ha tenido algunos efectos secundarios. Es normal que, durante el tratamiento, se prueben otras opciones". El director deportivo del equipo bávaro, Max Eberl, afirmó que el club apoya por completo al jugador, que quiso que su enfermedad se hiciera pública. Musiala no formará parte de la convocatoria para el partido del sábado, lo que le dará tiempo para adaptarse a que su situación sea ahora de dominio público. "Lo sabíamos desde la temporada pasada", dijo Eberl. "Los jugadores también lo sabían. Para nosotros se ha convertido en parte de la vida cotidiana. Ha cambiado algo en su medicación, por lo que estas situaciones han salido a la luz. Le daremos todo nuestro apoyo (...) Estamos en esto juntos». Kompany señaló que Musiala, que ha tenido dificultades para recuperar su mejor forma tras una grave lesión en julio de 2025 que lo dejó fuera de juego durante seis meses, ha dado grandes pasos y está listo para dar lo mejor de sí mismo. "Estoy totalmente tranquilo", afirmó Kompany. "Ahora espero el contraataque de Jamal. Tengo la sensación de que ahora cuenta con todos los recursos para dar esas respuestas. Como entrenador, sé que ha dado un gran paso adelante".

item.title: Mired in last place, Royals still 'don't quit' as Tigers visit
item.description: The Kansas City Royals will try to reach a season-high sixth consecutive win when they open a three-game series with the visiting Detroit Tigers on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Kansas City Royals will try to reach a season-high sixth consecutive win when they open a three-game series with the visiting Detroit Tigers on Friday night. In a 12-hit attack on Thursday, Kansas City earned a 6-2 victory that capped its first four-game sweep of the A's since 1994. The Royals' Bobby Witt Jr. had six hits and reached base 12 times in the series. He also scored eight runs and homered twice. "We are playing good baseball," Witt said. "We're playing the right way, playing hard and preparing the way we do and to go out there and compete." Salvador Perez and Michael Massey also recorded three hits apiece on Thursday. Even though the Royals are 19 games under .500 and in last place in the American League Central, Kansas City manager Matt Quatraro lauded his club's effort. "Our guys don't quit," he said. "Obviously, the guys aren't happy with where they are when it comes to the whole picture. But at this moment, they're making today the priority and playing good baseball all the way around." In the upcoming series, Kansas City likely will be without Maikel Garcia, who strained his left hamstring "pretty good" in the first inning Thursday, according to Quatraro, and Garcia is expected to return to the injured list. He was activated Monday from the injured list after a muscle strain to the left hand forced him to miss 46 games. He also missed six games after straining his right hamstring on June 30 against the Texas Rangers. Detroit also won't have its full complement of players. Nanager A.J. Hinch said he doesn't expect left fielder Riley Greene (right hamstring tightness) to return from the 10-day IL against the Royals. Greene has been out since Aug. 12 and might need a rehab assignment before rejoining the big league club. "The further you're away from major league pitching, the more you're going to have to consider a game or two," Hinch said. The Tigers had an off day Thursday after dropping two of three games at the Pittsburgh Pirates. The most recent was a 4-3 setback on Wednesday. Detroit has lost five of its past six games and has fallen into fourth place in the American League Central, five games behind the first-place Chicago White Sox, but is only 1 1/2 games out of the AL's final wild-card spot. Detroit closer Kenley Jansen served up the game-tying and game-winning solo homers in the ninth against Pittsburgh. Jansen, 38, is in his 17th season and has 16 saves but also five blown saves. Left-hander Noah Cameron (7-8, 4.16 ERA) is scheduled to start for the Royals on Friday. Cameron tossed a one-hit shutout in a 3-0 road win against the Los Angeles Angels on Sunday. He walked one and struck out eight in the complete game. Cameron has two career appearances, including one start, against the Tigers. Both have come this season, and he's 0-0 with a 2.45 ERA. On July 24 at Detroit, Cameron allowed two hits in seven shutout innings of relief with three walks and eight strikeouts in a 2-1 loss. Detroit will counter with right-hander Troy Melton (7-1, 1.71 ERA). Melton earned a no-decision in his most recent outing, allowing three runs (one earned) on eight hits with one walk and four strikeouts over 4 1/3 in a 4-3 home loss against the Chicago White Sox on Saturday. In three career appearances (one start) against the Royals, Melton is 0-0 with a 3.38 ERA. --Field Level Media

item.title: Nach mutmaßlichem Grenzvorfall - Finnland bestellt russischen Botschafter ein
item.description: Das finnische Außenministerium hat den russischen Botschafter wegen einer mutmaßlichen Luftraumverletzung durch ein Aufklärungsflugzeug einbestellt. Wie der finnische Grenzschutz am Freitag mitteilte, hat sich die Maschine vom Typ Il-20 am Vortag etwa drei Minuten lang im finnischen Luftraum befunden und ist dabei bis zu 8,7 Kilometer (4,7 Seemeilen) tief eingedrungen. Der Vorfall habe sich im westlichen Finnischen Meerbusen ereignet, eine Voruntersuchung sei eingeleitet worden. Die russische Botschaft in Finnland reagierte zunächst nicht auf eine Bitte um Stellungnahme.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Das finnische Außenministerium hat den russischen Botschafter wegen einer mutmaßlichen Luftraumverletzung durch ein Aufklärungsflugzeug einbestellt. Wie der finnische Grenzschutz am Freitag mitteilte, hat sich die Maschine vom Typ Il-20 am Vortag etwa drei Minuten lang im finnischen Luftraum befunden und ist dabei bis zu 8,7 Kilometer (4,7 Seemeilen) tief eingedrungen. Der Vorfall habe sich im westlichen Finnischen Meerbusen ereignet, eine Voruntersuchung sei eingeleitet worden. Die russische Botschaft in Finnland reagierte zunächst nicht auf eine Bitte um Stellungnahme. Finnland hatte Ende Juli wegen der Gefahr verirrter Drohnen einen Teil seines Luftraums geschlossen und den Seeverkehr vor seiner Südküste nahe der russischen Grenze eingeschränkt. Dies sollte den Behörden Gegenmaßnahmen ermöglichen, falls Drohnen in das Gebiet eindringen, hatte ein finnischer Militärsprecher Ende Juli erklärt. Hintergrund sind Vorfälle, bei denen ukrainische Militärdrohnen auf dem Weg zu Zielen in Russland in den Luftraum von Nato-Staaten wie Finnland, Estland, Lettland und Litauen eindringen. Die Ukraine und Nato-Staaten machen russische Störsender für die Kursabweichungen verantwortlich, während die Führung in Moskau der Ukraine eine absichtliche Steuerung vorwirft. Die finnische Außenministerin Elina Valtonen warnte im Februar [USN:L8N3ZA086 TEXT:"in einem Interview mit der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters"] davor, dass Russland zudem nach einem möglichen Friedensschluss in der Ukraine eine Gefahr für Europa bleiben werde. Solange Präsident Wladimir Putin an der Macht sei, bestehe die militärische Bedrohung fort, sagte Valtonen. Es sei wichtig, Russland dann nicht zu verharmlosen oder wieder Geschäfte mit dem Land zu machen, da Moskau das Geld für seine Rüstung nutzen werde.

item.title: Traders are bracing for an increasingly hawkish ECB
item.description: Money markets are bracing for an increasingly hawkish European Central Bank, wagering that geopolitical tensions will complicate its inflation battle and keep price pressures stubborn enough to lift the key deposit rate to almost 3% by late 2027.
item.dc:creator: Stefano Rebaudo
item.content:encoded: Money markets are bracing for an increasingly hawkish European Central Bank, wagering that geopolitical tensions will complicate its inflation battle and keep price pressures stubborn enough to lift the key deposit rate to almost 3% by late 2027. The ECB is expected to raise rates in September, after tightening in June to contain price pressures unleashed by the U.S.-Iran war-induced energy shock. Analysts say it's not just elevated oil prices, trading at over $90 a barrel , that are keeping investors on edge, but also the risk of tighter supplies of refined fuels, thin euro zone gas inventories and a conflict that could drag on beyond [USN:L1N43N10L TEXT:"November's U.S. midterm elections. "] That's playing out in rates markets where in addition to an anticipated September rate increase that would take the depo rate to 2.5%, bets on additional tightening are gaining momentum. Markets price a roughly 25% chance of the ECB deposit rate reaching 3% by March 2027 and an about 60% chance by September. Just a month ago they priced no chance of a move to 3% by March. Analysts said it's notable that rate hike bets held up even as oil pulled back from a peak of $120 hit in April and physical Brent premiums collapsed from $40 to $7, which suggests that traders remained worried about inflation and the ECB reaction even if oil retreats. “The baseline assumption is that a durable Middle East peace deal remains achievable before the U.S. midterm elections (in November),” said MUFG senior economist Henry Cook. “But if that starts to seem out of reach and energy pricing moves closer towards the ECB’s adverse scenario, we could see something more akin to a fully-fledged tightening cycle,” he added, mentioning a deposit rate to “at least 3%.” ENERGY SHOCK Investors warned that the [USN:L6N43M0M9 TEXT:"war"] could weigh on the energy market long-term, fuelling inflation. "Crack spreads will remain elevated for the foreseeable future, with the markets for refined products far tighter than is the case for crude," said Mark Dowding, chief investment officer at BlueBay Fixed Income, mentioning also damage related to the war in Ukraine. The crack spread measures the margin between refined products such as diesel and crude oil, and is often used as an indicator of oil-related inflation pressures. Euro area inflation is also driven by the natural gas market, with storage levels at the [USN:L8N43M0VB TEXT:"lowest for this time of year in over a decade"] amid expectations the region will fall short of its goal before the winter, due partly to hot weather increasing use of appliances such as air conditioning units to cool down. Capital Economics said the last time inventories were close to this level was in 2021, when prices reached a peak of over €170. They are currently [USN:L1N44F0OT TEXT:"at around €65"]. FADING DEFLATIONARY FORCES Inflation could prove stickier than expected as expansionary fiscal policy, green-transition investment, defence spending and persistent labour market tightness reverse some of the disinflationary forces seen before the pandemic. The euro zone economy has also proved resilient, with data on Friday showing business activity growing at its [USN:L6N44I0JD TEXT:"fastest pace this year"]. The five-year euro short-term rate overnight index swap , a proxy for the euro zone's neutral rate, reached roughly 2.85% on Thursday, its highest since November 2023. The neutral rate is the level at which monetary policy is expected to settle in the medium term. “We could also say that the (policy rate) market pricing reflects the assumption that the war will continue until November," said ING's global head of macro research Carsten Brzeski.

Aug 21 : Denmark's football association (DBU) has vowed to find a credible alternative to FIFA President Gianni Infantino in next year's election, declaring on Friday that it had lost confidence in the head of world soccer's governing body. The DBU said Infantino's aborted proposal to sell commercial stakes in FIFA tournaments, including the World Cup, had created "a fundamental crisis of confidence in FIFA's leadership" that could not be repaired by withdrawals or apologies. The DBU said it did not support Infantino in the 2023 presidential election and would not do so at the next election, which will take place at the 77th FIFA Congress in Rabat, Morocco, on March 18. "We are pleased that several federations are now withdrawing their support," the DBU said in a statement after a board meeting.

"DBU, together with UEFA and our international colleagues, will work to ensure that the member associations in the presidential election in 2027 have a real choice and a credible alternative that can unite FIFA across confederations and rebuild the trust that has been broken." FIFA apologised earlier this month to its member associations for mistakes made over the abandoned proposal, but its leadership reaffirmed its support for Infantino after a crisis meeting in Morocco. "Confidence in Gianni Infantino is gone, and neither the withdrawal of the proposal nor the subsequent apology for the handling of the process changes that assessment," the DBU added. "The developments of the past week also only further emphasise the board's desire for a new FIFA president." The deadline for presidential election nominations is November 18, yet no one else has formally declared their candidacy so far. Infantino is seeking a fourth term until 2031 but several national associations and key officials have withdrawn support for the Swiss administrator. The sport's regional powerhouses have also discussed a potential vote of no confidence against the FIFA chief. Infantino is under pressure from three confederations to resign, including Europe's UEFA, Asia's AFC and CONCACAF, which represents North and Central America and the Caribbean. However, he continues to enjoy the backing of the African confederation (CAF) and several Asian nations that have pledged their support for his re-election, while heavyweights like Argentina and Mexico have also backed him. The DBU also echoed UEFA's boycott threat, adding that it would not be participating in FIFA tournaments unless it receives "necessary guarantees" that FIFA will not open its governance and tournaments to private investors ever again.

Source: Reuters

China launches biggest ever auto recall campaign over door handle safety

Tesla China-made Model 3 vehicles are seen during a delivery event at its factory in Shanghai, China, on Jan 7, 2020. (File photo: Reuters/Aly Song)

FAST

BEIJING: Eleven carmakers, including Tesla and Xiaomi, launched software updates and vehicle recalls on Friday (Aug 21), the companies said, in China's largest-ever automotive recall campaign, as regulators tighten scrutiny of emergency door-release systems in electric vehicles. Most of the actions, classified as product recalls under Chinese regulations, address concerns that emergency mechanical door release handles may be difficult to locate or operate during emergencies. Nine of the 11 automakers, including Tesla and Xiaomi, will install warning labels free of charge to identify the handles, while most will also deploy over-the-air (OTA) software updates. The sweeping campaign comes as Beijing steps up oversight of the EV industry and introduces tougher safety requirements, as automakers roll out new technologies amid a fierce price war in the world's largest auto market.

Tesla will recall 2.98 million imported and China-made Model 3, Model Y, Model S and Model X vehicles from Sep 25, it told the State Administration for Market Regulation, according to the regulator's statement. The US automaker said mechanical emergency door-release handles may be difficult to identify following a severe collision and electrical system failure, potentially hindering occupants' escape or rescuers' access, the statement said. Tesla's remedy includes warning labels and an OTA update that automatically lowers vehicle windows after a collision. At least six car brands, including Tesla, Xiaomi, Leapmotor, Xpeng, Zeekr and Lynk & Co, announced their largest recalls on record on Friday, according to their filings to SAMR. China is set to ban concealed or "hidden" door handles from 2027, becoming the first country to phase out a design popularised by Tesla and widely adopted by domestic EV makers. The design, which allows doors to be opened using a key fob, smartphone or a press-operated mechanism, has attracted regulatory scrutiny in China and the US over concerns that the handles may be difficult to access during emergencies.
